Apple-200688439.description:

It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.   

At Apple, we believe in the power of technology to enrich people’s lives. Everything we build is designed—first and foremost—with helping people in mind. We believe advertising is no different, and that its value should come from how it benefits customers, not what it extracts from them. Our Apple Ads team applies that belief by delivering ads that add value, helping people discover content, supporting creators, and protecting and respecting everyone’s privacy.   

Our technology powers ads in the App Store, Apple News, Stocks, and Apple TV. We help developers and marketers of all sizes drive discovery of their apps across the App Store. Our display ads in Apple News and Stocks aid advertisers in promoting their products alongside trusted content in a brand-safe environment, while supporting publishers and journalists. We help advertisers connect with captivated audiences with our sponsorship integrations and experiences in live sports on Apple TV. Everything we do is with the unwavering commitment to privacy you expect from Apple. Because when advertising is done right, it benefits everyone.

We are seeking an experienced Client Partner to join our Apple Ads Gaming team to help developers with promotions and discovery across Apple Services globally. You have very strong communications and interpersonal skills, you are customer focused, team oriented, proactive and resourceful. You have the ability to work independently to meet revenue and business objectives. You have a proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in performance advertising in the mobile and app developer space.

Manage relationships with clients and agencies in the performance marketing space
Develop a strategy for long-term success across your portfolio of clients
Act as a thought-leader with both clients and agencies
Work closely with your Manager & Platform Specialist team to ensure proper execution and alignment with customer objectives

Apple-200688352.title: Color MQE, SoftGoods
Apple-200688352.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that encourages the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it!   

As a Manufacturing Quality Engineer (MQE) for SoftGoods, you will be responsible for the selection, implementation, and optimization of manufacturing processes and quality planning throughout the product lifecycle. You will apply mechanical and materials engineering expertise to evaluate part designs for manufacturability, identify capable fabrication technologies, and establish rigorous quality control architectures from early prototyping through mass production.

In this role, you will work hand-in-hand with Apple’s design teams and global supply base to develop novel metrology techniques, statistical process control plans, and audit methodologies. You will lead technical escalations, assess production capability metrics, and drive continuous quality improvements across supplier factories, ensuring flawless execution of cosmetic and structural product requirements at global scale.

Planning, proposing, and leading experiments to produce timely and accurate analyses used to drive design, development, and supply chain decisions.  
Assessing the suitability of a fabrication technology for a given part design. Planning validation exercises to demonstrate initial feasibility as well as manufacturing capability. Analyzing results of validation exercises and provide technical recommendations.  
Reviewing progress of development activities at supplier locations and serve as point of escalation for critical process related issues.  
Actively participate in the program planning and monitoring process assuming responsibility for key work you're doing at all milestones.  
Provide technical direction and guidance to other Quality Engineers supporting the implementation of the PQP.  
Assess measurability and creatively address concerns directly with partners. Identify and direct studies to implement improvements in measuring method where appropriate.  
Establish audit procedures appropriate to program and supplier to ensure consistency to Apple quality standards. Implement FAI and Cp/Cpk reviews of mechanical parts.  
Monitor each supplier's performance through measurement of production line statistics, company inspections, and audits. Prepare summary of performance and communicate to appropriate management to ensure effective corrective action plans can be promptly implemented.
Apple-200688352.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Experience supporting new product launches from a quality planning, quality engineering, or product development perspective.
Experience developing process quality plans, supplier quality audits, and driving corrective actions and failure analysis efforts.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience with soft materials (mainly PU/textiles) is strongly preferred. Experience with mechanical fabricated parts, or adhesives, glues, jigs, fixtures, tooling, injection molding, plastics experience may be acceptable.
Extensive knowledge of mechanical quality and reliability concepts, supplier management, and general manufacturing operations.
Project management experience and an understanding of DFx principles is a plus.
Deep understanding of DOE, GD&T, SPC theory and practical application experience is helpful.
Demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills. Domestic travel required. Experience with highly cosmetic parts a plus.

Apple-200684738.title: Corporate PR Lead (based in Shanghai/Beijing)
Apple-200684738.description:
The people here at Apple don’t just build products—they craft the kind of wonder that has revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.

Apple's Worldwide Communications team informs the world about our innovative products and services, and the values that drive everything we do. The team includes professionals with backgrounds in corporate communications strategy, journalism, media relations, buzz marketing, and event production. We’re looking for trailblazing, collaborative professionals from a variety of creative fields. If that’s you, then your next home may be here. Come and do the best and most exciting work of your career at Apple! 

The Greater China team develops and manages world-class communication strategies to support Apple’s continued growth in this dynamic region. We are seeking a Corporate PR Lead to drive the strategy, planning, team management and development, execute programs and initiatives flawlessly with impactful results, and provide strategic counsel to cross functions in the region and worldwide stakeholders. This role will drive the development and implementation of a strategic focused strategy to proactively communicate Apple’s contribution in the community, values, support to developers and customers to targeted media, influencers and stakeholders.

In this role, you will be leading a team of PR Managers who you will actively develop through nurturing and building capabilities tied to our competency architecture and leadership attributes.

This role is expected to be hands-on, working day-to-day with the team and other critical functions including Government Affairs (GA), MD Office, Legal, Apple Retail, Product Marketing, Marcom, Developer Relations, Services and Finance to build our corporate narrative and champion Apple’s contribution and values. The role will also require to lead C-suit of Apple executive’s China trips to cut through our storytelling around contribution to the market and innovation story by partnering with Product PR and broader stakeholders. 

You will partner closely with worldwide team to align on messaging and global initiatives while also defining and implementing market-specific ideas for current and future stories. You will rely on your relationship-driven ability to work cross-functionally and cross-borders with worldwide communications  to ensure global communications plans are implemented locally.

In addition, you must have the capacity to handle crisis and other reactive PR situations with grace and ease, knowing when and how to respond to media inquiries. You will identify and escalate potential public issues that may impact Apple, diffuse rumors, and resolve conflicting messages.

Lead the planning and delivery of Corporate Communications initiatives and campaigns that meet both worldwide and local objectives. Work with teams globally and locally to find opportunities and implement the initiatives and ideas flawlessly. We expect the initiatives and ideas are high quality, reflecting Apple standard and values, with strategic focus, and with demonstration of innovation year over year. 
Possess strategic mindset, be sensitive to the market trends and happenings, and have a good read of regulators’ policy. Use the knowledge to develop a set of long term strategy and actionable robust programs to tell stories including but not limited to values, giving, developers and retail that can set Apple apart and resonate well with China audiences. 
Provide strategic counsel, guidance, support, and resources when needed for the local business team including MD office, sales, retail, marketing, legal, finance, people, and Services.
Demonstrate leadership with Apple quality. Manage, mentor and coach, develop the team to deliver high impact results. Show up as a trustworthy and collaborative leader when working with other functions. 
Use your first-class knowledge of the media landscape in Greater China to proactively broaden and deepen our contacts with technology, state-owned, and business outlets.
Have your finger on the pulse of the constantly evolving media and social landscape. Spot the opportunities that arise from these changes and recommend how we can capitalize on them to improve coverage.
Supervise and track key coverage for your market and share news with the wider Greater China and global teams when relevant.
Maintain a network of agency resources in the region as required to support the execution of local initiatives and programs.
Apple-200684738.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
15+ years of experience in a global organization in a consumer and/or corporate PR capacity; 15+ years of experience in a global organization in a consumer and/or corporate PR capacity;
Experience delivering public relations campaigns that create impact.
Experience managing change and ambiguity while leading teams and building interpersonal relationships.
Experience developing and delivering communications that convey a clear understanding of a product narrative to stakeholders. Ability to analyze complex information to solve problems and prioritize tasks in a dynamic environment.
Ability to continually prioritize and multi-task in a dynamic, creative, fast-paced environment.
Highly collaborative with extraordinary social and interpersonal relationship-building skills.
Proficiency in Mandarin and English.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience from Technology and/or Consumer Goods sectors
Knowledge of China’s regulation that relevant to Apple’s business. 
Network of media, journalist contacts and high profile influencers in Greater China. Knowledge of social media platforms and digital media trends.
University degree in Business, Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or Arts.

Apple-200608974.title: Creative Director - Experience Design (XD)
Apple-200608974.description:
Marketing Communications (Marcom) is the creatively-led global team that oversees Apple’s consumer facing marketing. We ensure the flawless development and execution of world-class communications across all medias and platforms. Every day, hundreds of millions of Apple customers around the world interact with our products. We drive the strategy and creative work that provide both new and existing customers with simple, engaging and inspiring marketing experiences.

The Greater China team develops and manages world-class marketing communication efforts that support Apple’s rapid growth in this region. This includes all consumer-facing communications across Localization, Advertising, Social, Retail, Partner, Interactive & Digital platforms, as well as support for Video & Motion Graphics.

As the Creative Director - Experience Design, you will lead the strategy and design for all of our interactive and omnichannel experiences in China. You will support a cross-disciplinary team of experts across Experience Design, Interactive Visual Design, and Writing. Your day-to-day will involve close collaboration with Interactive Creative Directors and Design teams to define the end-to-end customer journey, seamlessly connecting digital platforms to in-store experiences for Apple and our partners.

The Creative Director - Experience Design has a deep passion for experience strategy, user-centered design, and crafting intuitive customer journeys. You bring broad experience in XD leadership, strong communication and presentation skills, and the ability to foster a positive, collaborative environment. You also understand the nuances of information architecture, usability, digital platforms, physical retail spaces, and systematic design logic. 

In this role, you will work closely with creative leadership and cross-functional partners across Worldwide, Geo, and Greater China Marcom teams.

Define the experience strategy for China, conceptualizing how customers interact with Apple’s brand and products across digital campaigns, social platforms, apple.com, and physical in-store environments.
Collaborate with Worldwide, Geo, and local China teams—as well as Interactive Creative Directors, Design teams, retail experts, writers, and creative technologists—to bring strategic concepts to life and produce exceptional work.
Guide teams through strategic concept development, providing expertise in experience strategy, system design, usability, analytics, user testing, and omnichannel marketing.
Listen to perspectives, provide thoughtful feedback, and resolve challenges within your team and across Marcom, ensuring all voices are heard and considered.
Articulate the strategic thinking behind your design decisions, presenting work clearly to senior creative staff, product marketing managers, and Apple executives.
Connect high-level strategies across online, retail, channel, events, and advertising to ensure a unified customer journey—whether on a screen or in a physical space.
Work with project managers and creative leads to ensure schedules are realistic and deadlines are met.
Discover and nurture new talent, build your team for an ongoing calendar of projects, and manage outside agencies and vendors when needed.
Apple-200608974.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
A portfolio or work samples demonstrating applied knowledge of experience strategy, usability, user-centered design, and content strategy. Your XD documents should include strategic frameworks, sitemaps, user flows, wireframes, and spatial or physical journey maps. 
12+ years of overall experience, including 3 years of management experience as a leader driving experience strategy in a creative-focused digital agency or in-house at a leading brand.
Strong written and spoken Chinese and English skills to effectively communicate and collaborate with international team members.
A global perspective with an awareness of the latest digital trends and strategic methodologies.
Deep exposure to local culture in China and its unique interactive and retail landscape.
Proven ability to map and orchestrate cohesive, strategically driven user journeys that span digital platforms and physical in-store experiences.
Fluent in analytics, usability tests, and other forms of qualitative and quantitative feedback to inform and validate your strategies.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Your work is grounded in clear strategic thinking and original ideas, executed with structural logic, usability, and meticulous attention to detail.
You use a range of tools to express your experience strategies and concepts, from hand sketches and wireframes to user flows and rapid prototypes.
Excellent management, mentorship, and interpersonal skills. You can present, collaborate, and respectfully debate with senior partners in a clear and articulate manner.
A Bachelor’s degree with a multidisciplinary educational background such as human-computer interaction, psychology, computer science, information sciences, commerce, or a related discipline.

Apple-200677505.title: Cross Functional Test Lead — Retail Engineering
Apple-200677505.description:
Apple’s IS&T Retail Engineering team is seeking a SDET to own quality across our retail ecosystem — spanning eCommerce backend services, SAP integrations, and cross-functional end-to-end workflows. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you’ll architect automation frameworks, lead testing strategy across multiple concurrent projects, and drive quality standards organization-wide.

You’ll work at the intersection of backend development, test automation, and program coordination — ensuring that features shipping to apple.com/shop and supporting retail systems meet Apple’s bar for reliability, performance, and customer experience.

Test Architecture & Automation Infrastructure

Design, architect, and maintain scalable, modular automated test frameworks (Java-based) for backend services, REST APIs, SAP workflows, and web/mobile applications. 
Build and integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous deployment across retail platform environments. 
Drive API testing (REST Assured/Karate), UI testing (Playwright/Selenium), mobile testing (Appium/XCUITest), and enterprise SAP automation. 
Define end-to-end test data strategies, mock services, and environment setups for complex integration testing. 
Backend Tooling & Systems Design

Design and build custom backend test tooling, test harness applications, and execution infrastructure using Java and Spring Boot. 
Architect solutions for multi-threaded, high-throughput test execution environments to minimize build/test cycle times. 
Work with SQL and NoSQL databases for automated test data validation and system state verification. 
Maintain clean code standards, system design documentation, and framework guides. 
Cross-Functional Leadership & Quality Strategy

Lead and coordinate testing efforts across multiple concurrent retail projects with overlapping release schedules. 
Establish organization-wide QA standards, testing guidelines, and automation best practices. 
Coordinate cross-functional onsite and offshore engineering activities. 
Conduct risk assessments, define mitigation strategies, and present quality updates to Senior Management. 
Partner with Product Managers, Developers, and Business Stakeholders to translate complex requirements into robust test strategies. 
Quality Advocacy & Continuous Improvement

Advocate for "shift-left" testing practices, testability in software design, and high quality standards across teams. 
Monitor quality metrics, track automation coverage goals, and provide actionable status reports to stakeholders. 
Proactively identify technical bottlenecks, environment risks, and systemic blockers.
Apple-200677505.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
7+ years of professional experience in software development and test automation. 
5+ years of hands-on development experience in Java, including building applications/tooling with Spring Boot or equivalent frameworks. 
3+ years leading or coordinating cross-functional QA/testing initiatives across global teams. 
Hands-on experience architecting automated testing frameworks for backend APIs (REST Assured, Karate, or similar) and web/mobile UI (Playwright, Selenium, Appium, XCUITest). 
Experience with enterprise integration or SAP workflow automation (e.g., Worksoft, Tosca, or equivalent). 
Solid understanding of the SDLC, STLC, test data management, and CI/CD tools (Git, Jenkins, Docker/Kubernetes). 
Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate technical risks and strategy to Senior Management and cross-functional partners.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience testing large-scale eCommerce or enterprise retail platforms. 
Secondary scripting skills in Python for test data manipulation, automation scripting, or tooling. 
Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) for distributed test execution environments. 
Exposure to messaging queues/event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and microservice validation. 
Familiarity with AI/ML-assisted testing tools and frameworks (GenAI integrations). 
Track record of performance, load, and scalability testing in distributed environments.

At Apple, inclusion is a shared responsibility, and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.

Our main goal is to deliver a magical, personal digital experience where customers can shop, buy and learn everything Apple, wherever they are. Each customer should feel like they are our only customer and our job is to set the bar for the experience they receive. To run such an extraordinary store, it takes extraordinary people, and we are looking for someone to help us do extraordinary things.

The Digital Commerce Management (DCM) team are responsible for maintaining and managing all customer-facing content on the Apple Store Online and the Apple Store App, Tmall Flagship Store and Douyin Store. Our mission is to deliver an engaging and flawless shopping experience by continuously improving the quality of content presented to customers while scaling to meet the increasing demands of new geographies, languages, and devices.

We are seeking a dynamic, highly-experienced Digital Delivery Manager (DDM) to join DCM team. The role balances technical coordination, workflow optimization and cross-team alignment to scale Customer Lifecycle Management (CLM) capabilities while ensuring consistent, high-quality customer experience delivery.

You’ll take end-to-end accountability for process optimization and risk mitigation: spotting risks upfront, standardizing delivery processes, building repeatable solution templates, and iterating efficiency to scale our CLM operations sustainably.

Manage and deploy operational roadmaps; define work-streams, milestones, owners and dependencies; drive cross-functional delivery and proactively resolve technical and operational blockers.
Own end-to-end launch execution, ensuring solution readiness, implementation quality and coordinated deployment across relevant digital commerce platforms; oversee issue resolution and remediation to deliver successful launches.
Standardize delivery methodologies, drive change management for evolving digital content-production workflows. 
Influence cross-functional partner teams with timely, actionable insights, and optimize systems and processes for the creation of product copy and rich media assets (images, videos) to support product launches, campaigns, and promotions.
Strategize, plan, and test the delivery of new platform features and capabilities that elevate digital customer shopping experiences on ASO and marketplaces.

It's the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation running through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you'll do more than join something. You'll add something.

Ecosystem Products and Partnerships is the organization responsible for developing, scaling, and delivering the hardware products, accessories, and partner-integrated devices (including Home, Beats, and 2PP) that expand and enrich the core product ecosystem.

Apple is looking for a self-driven, passionate APAC Engineering Program Manager to lead NPI projects, focusing primarily on Home and Beats accessories with potential opportunities in 3rd-party joint design. Ideally, you are an excellent communicator in both Mandarin and English who can quickly grasp and resolve complex issues, and collaborate effectively across departments and management levels within Apple and its partners. The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and solve problems creatively is a must.

Closely work with upstream vendors to capture x-functional team’s design updates. Make sure material arrive at FATP on time and incorporate into build plan.
Closely monitor equipment / fixture buy off status w/ x-functional team including quality inspection, assembly and testing.
Create & maintain the build matrix to reflect latest request from x-functional teams & DOEs arrangement, with clear traceability of deviation if any, including material, assembly and testing.
Host daily build open / close meeting, aligning on build recipe, test rule, I/O, major issues FA progress etc. to ensure on time and on quality build deliverables.
Consolidate x-functional team’s allocation and data collection request for units routing management.
Quotation review, budget / PR request and approval.

Ability to travel extensively (up to 50%) within China and Vietnam.

Familiar with NPI process, be good at x-functional collaboration and risk management.

Apple-200604125.title: Enclosure Global Supply Manager
Apple-200604125.description:
Apple is a place where amazing people collaborate to do their best work. Just get ready to dream big.

The people here at Apple don’t just build products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that encourages the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

Imaging what you could do here. At Apple, creative ideas have a way of becoming wonderful products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there’s no telling what you could accomplish.

Our material global supply management team is responsible for the sourcing, manufacturing development, execution and production of Apple's differentiated and unique mechanical enclosure parts. 

Part of Apple's core business is the creation and development of our world-class mechanical / industrial designs and as such, the management of the supply chains is required to be equally unique, innovative and specialized.

Due to the importance of this discipline in the definition of Apple's brand, this business group must innovate not only our products, but also the very business processes by which we accomplish our objectives. The complicated balance between the need to achieve ground breaking mechanical developments and business execution creates challenges that drive processes that require a bridge from engineering risk to manufacturing capability to business needs.

-  Supply chain management: identification, development, and management of existing and developing Apple material suppliers.

-  Cost management: development, negotiation and execution of a material cost strategy.

-  Supplier capabilities bring up: An understanding of materials manufacturing processes/ techniques is important to better evaluate supplier capabilities and opportunities for Apple.

-  Cross-functional support: with Apple's industrial design, product development and operations teams.

-  Build Support: on site management of material manufacturing partners to manage the development builds, risk mitigation and ramp.

-  On time delivery: schedule, capacity and supply planning to meet Apple’s production demand.

-  Risk Mitigation: evaluation of technical and business risks using data based analysis and developing sound risk mitigation alternatives.

Typically requires 6+ years of demonstrated experience in Supply Chain Management / Manufacturing background
Proficiency in English & Mandarin written and spoken communication.
Knowing to use Excel/ Power point/Keynote/ Numbers

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Solid communication skills, ability to work in multinational environments, driven and motivated by accomplishing world-class objectives.
Ability to travel Internationally and up to 50%
Understand costing concepts, cost reduction, modeling, etc.
Knowledge of any of the following preferred: Raw Material, Mechanical subassemblies, enclosures, casings, plastics, grinding, stamping, CNC, mills, lathes, etc.
Experience in Production plan/Supply and Demand Management/ Liability analysis
Education: MSME or BSME/IE or equivalent. MBA a plus.

Apple-200687864.description:
Imagine what you could do here! At Apple, great ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. We provide equal opportunities. 

The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

WHO WE ARE:
Our enclosure global supply management team is responsible for the sourcing, manufacturing development, execution and production of differentiated and unique mechanical enclosure parts. 

Part of our core business is the creation and development of our world-class mechanical / industrial designs and as such, the management of the supply chain is required to be equally unique, innovative and specialized. 

Due to the importance of this subject area in the definition of Apple's brand, this business group must be able to innovate not only our products, but also the very business processes by which we accomplish our objectives. 

The complicated balance between the need to achieve ground breaking mechanical developments and business execution creates challenges that drive processes that require a bridge from engineering risk to manufacturing capability to business needs.

-  Supply chain management: be responsible for identification, development, negotiation and management of existing and developing mechanical suppliers.

-  Cost: develop, negotiate and execute of a part and assembly cost strategy. You will need to have an understanding of mechanical manufacturing techniques is important to better evaluate supplier capabilities and opportunities for Apple.

-  Cross-functional support: work with industrial design, product development and operations teams.

-  Build Support: lead on-site management of mechanical enclosure manufacturing partners to manage the development builds, risk mitigation and ramp.

-  On time delivery: manage schedule, capacity and supply planning to meet Apple’s production demand. Risk Mitigation: evaluation of technical and business risks using data based analysis and developing sound risk mitigation alternatives.
Apple-200687864.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Master’s or Bachelor’s degree enrolled.
Proven interpersonal skills, ability to work in multinational environments, driven and motivated by accomplishing world-class objectives.
Good learning capability.
Able to travel frequently.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
MBA is a plus.
Internship Period: 6 months
Solid program management skillset and ability to lead peers and work well with others is essential.
Knowledge of mechanical engineering and development, manufacturing practices/techniques, or other technical background would be a definite plus.
Experience in massive data analysis, coding and machine learning would be a plus.

Apple-200688150.title: Engineering Program Manager, Retail Fraud - Strategic Data Solutions
Apple-200688150.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there’s no telling what you could accomplish. The people here at Apple don’t just craft products; they build the kind of wonder that has revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that supports the innovation that runs through everything we do. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

Apple’s Strategic Data Solutions (SDS) team is seeking an Engineering Program Manager (EPM) to help drive the delivery of fraud detection and decisioning programs that protect Apple’s Retail ecosystem. 

EPMs conceptualize, build, and deliver solutions that protect Apple and its customers from fraud without sacrificing customer experience. Apple-200693369.title: Environment Operations Intern
Apple-200693369.description:
At Apple, we design our products to be less carbon intensive by prioritizing the use of recycled and renewable content. In 2025, 30 percent of all materials shipped in our products, by weight, came from recycled or renewable sources. Within Environment, Social & Community Innovation (ESCI), the Recycled Content Claims team supports this mission by managing end-to-end supply chain traceability, reviewing thousands of material records each year, and verifying environmental claims across products.

As we continue to expand recycled material usage across product lines, we are adding new traceability and data features into our internal engineering platform. We are looking for an organized, motivated intern to help gather requirements, test new features, and support pilot builds.

You will help roll out and test new Recycled Content (RC) tracking features inside our engineering platform. In this role, you will map how material certs and supply chain data move across teams, turn operational needs into clear system requirements, and help run pilot workflows.

• Requirements: Work with internal teams to map current workflows and define needed system features.
• Feature Testing: Partner with the system team to translate user needs into practical features and track setup progress.
• Pilot Workflows: Help plan and run pilot workflows on target modules to ensure the process runs smoothly.
• User Feedback: Track how teams interact with the new features during builds and gather feedback to improve the platform.
Apple-200693369.requirements:

Master’s degree student in Operations Research, Data Science, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Information Systems, or related quantitative disciplines.
Solid foundation in data analysis, quantitative modeling, or system logic (experience with Python, SQL, Power BI, or advanced Excel modeling is a plus).
Available to join internship for 3 months full-time. 
Excellent communication skills, both verbally and written, in English and Mandarin.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience in multi-tasking and project management.
Passion for recycled materials, supply chain traceability or environmental data.
Analytical with a keen ability to distill down complicated data and processes.
Can relay detailed processes into clear messaging for internal partners.

Apple-200678628.title: Finance Process Lead – Centralized Testing Team (FIS)
Apple-200678628.description:
Apple is a place where extraordinary people gather to do their best work. Together we create products and experiences people once couldn’t have imagined — and now can’t imagine living without. If you’re excited by the idea of making a real impact, a career with Apple might be your dream job… Just be prepared to dream big. Teamwork is important at Apple, and every day you will connect with and be supported by your peers and colleagues at one of the most diverse and inclusive companies in the world. As an individual, you will contribute to our continued success and play a key role within your job function.

About the Team: Finance Integrated Solutions (FIS) drives Finance technology solutions, enabling Apple’s growth and expansion of products and services — championing compliance, cross-functional alignment, and on-time delivery with quality and integrity. We are a global team driving the Finance track for cross-functional initiatives. From GEO expansion, new products, and services to compliance, we bring together Program Managers, Test Leads, Instructional Designers, and Change Leads to move work forward for Finance.

As a Finance Process Lead on the Centralized Finance Testing Team, you will ensure the quality, accuracy, and stability of Apple’s global SAP Finance ecosystem through advanced manual and automated testing practices. You will drive end-to-end quality assurance across core SAP Finance modules—including O2C, P2P, R2R, H2R, and connected boundary systems. Partnering closely with finance business stakeholders, SAP functional consultants, and engineering teams, you will validate critical system changes, scale test automation frameworks, and safeguard operational integrity.

Execute end-to-end manual test scenarios and schedule automated regression suites across SAP Finance modules and integrated boundary systems.
Design, build, and maintain Worksoft Certify automated test scripts and reusable process libraries for core finance workflows, including GR/IR, payment posting, and journal entries.
Develop and maintain Selenium WebDriver test automation scripts and frameworks using Java or Python with TestNG/JUnit for SAP Fiori and web-based finance portals.
Integrate automated testing with test management platforms (such as Jira and ALM), maintain automation suites through system changes, and analyze execution results to report quality metrics.
Leverage Worksoft Analyze for business process discovery and test suite optimization, driving the setup and execution of Continuous Process Testing (CPT).
Partner closely with global Apple business units—including Retail, Online Store, Internet Services, Global Business Solutions (GBS), AppleCare, Operations, and IS&T—to validate critical test scenarios on time.
Innovate quality engineering practices and share testing methodologies with members of the broader global team.
Apple-200678628.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field.
8+ years of progressive experience in SAP Finance business and systems testing utilizing test management platforms such as Jira or ALM.
5+ years of hands-on testing and automation expertise across SAP Finance modules within SAP S/4HANA and SAP ECC environments.
3+ years of test automation background building and managing Worksoft Certify projects, process libraries, and test result dashboards.
Demonstrated proficiency in building Selenium WebDriver automation scripts utilizing Java or Python with TestNG or JUnit frameworks.
Bilingual proficiency in both English and Mandarin (verbal and written).
Track record of cross-functional partnership across technical teams and business stakeholders, with strong analytical problem-solving rooted in data-driven decisions.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
ISTQB or CSTQB Foundation or Advanced Level Testing Certification.
SAP Certified Associate certification (such as SAP Activate Project Manager or SAP S/4HANA Finance).
Worksoft Certify Certification.
Hands-on testing background with SAP S/4HANA Fiori.
Working knowledge of basic ABAP debugging for test data analysis and defect investigation.
Practical experience with API testing utilizing tools such as Postman or RestAssured.
Familiarity with integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins or Azure DevOps.

Apple-200675943.title: Financial Analyst – Greater China Sales Finance, Route-to-Market (RTM)
Apple-200675943.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Do you love thinking analytically? Are you passionate about applying financial acumen to navigate complex commercial challenges? 

The Greater China Sales Finance team is seeking a motivated and analytical Financial Analyst to support commercial investment decisions, evaluate go-to-market strategies, and modernize finance workflows through data analytics and technology.

In this role, you will serve as a commercial finance partner to Sales and cross-functional teams, as well as a key liaison to Worldwide (WW) Sales Finance. You will oversee the financial modeling, governance, and analysis for sales promotions and affordability / consumer offer programs across designated product lines. You will evaluate demand forecasts, run scenario plays to assess margin impacts, manage approvals and contracting, and ensure end-to-end accounting accuracy from payout calculations to Contra-Revenue accruals. In addition, you will leverage modern data tools and AI technologies to drive process efficiency and scale business analytics.

Commercial Promotions & Demand Generation:
Partner with Sales and Planning teams to understand forecast trends and business dynamics.
Design and evaluate demand generation programs; conduct scenario modeling and sensitivity analyses to assess volume uplift, revenue/margin impact, and overall financial viability.
Align with WW stakeholders to secure program approvals.
Manage end-to-end program execution, including contract coordination, in-quarter tracking, post-program payout calculations, and quarter-end Contra-Revenue forecast accruals.

Affordability & Consumer Offer Programs:
Collaborate with Sales and business partners to evaluate and track affordability and consumer offer initiatives.
Ensure financial commitments are accurately reflected.

Market Intelligence & Industry Tracking:
Monitor relevant market developments, competitor movements, pricing architecture, and promotional offers.
Translate market observations into actionable financial insights to support commercial planning and sales strategy.

Data Analytics, Automation & AI Adoption:
Streamline and automate recurring financial analyses and workflows using SQL, Excel, and analytics platforms (e.g., Dataiku).
Maintain an open mindset toward emerging technologies, actively exploring and leveraging AI tools to enhance daily productivity and reporting efficiency.
Apple-200675943.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor or Master degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Analytics, or a quantitative discipline.
2–5+ years of relevant experience in commercial finance, sales finance, FP&A, or business / data analytics.
Solid understanding of commercial finance principles, revenue recognition, and margin analysis.
Strong quantitative and modeling skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Excel and hands-on experience using SQL to query datasets.
Sound analytical and problem-solving abilities, comfortable working with evolving business forecasts and navigating ambiguity.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both English and Mandarin.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Familiarity with data manipulation, data pipeline, or BI tools such as Dataiku, MySQL, Tableau, or Python.
Practical experience leveraging AI / LLM tools to optimize workflows and accelerate analytical tasks.
Experience in commercial finance in Technology, Consumer Electronics, or Retail.
Fast learner with intellectual curiosity and a proactive, collaborative approach to problem solving.

Apple-200621805.title: GCR Strategic Accounts Field Marketer, Gaming, Apple Ads
Apple-200621805.description:
At Apple, we focus deeply on our customers’ experience. Apple Ads brings this same approach to advertising, helping people find exactly what they’re looking for and helping advertisers grow their businesses.

Our technology powers ads and sponsorships across Apple Services, including the App Store, Apple News, Apple Maps, and sports on Apple TV. Everything we do is designed for trust, connection, and impact: We respect user privacy, integrate advertising thoughtfully into the experience, and deliver value for advertisers of all sizes—from small app developers to big, global brands. Because when advertising is done right, it benefits everyone.

Do you have extensive experience in the gaming vertical and a track record of successfully partnering with sales leaders to deliver impactful B2B marketing deliverables that fuel regional business demand? Are you a strategic and resourceful business-minded content marketer, a critical thinker, and a stand out achiever?

We’re looking for an experienced marketer to drive sales marketing programs and enablement for managed accounts in the gaming vertical across the Greater China Region. As part of the global Field Marketing team and the trusted local marketing expert on Apple’s advertising solutions, the GCR Field Marketer will play a pivotal role in demonstrating the value of Apple advertising to gaming clients across the region. 

From shaping the approach to executing the work, this is a hands-on role. This person will contribute to locally informed vertical marketing strategies while taking the lead to develop, adapt, and deliver materials for regional priority audiences, segments, and opportunities. Working closely with marketing, sales, and insights teams, they'll gather ongoing feedback to differentiate our advertising solutions, strengthen channel messaging, and expand customer engagement efforts. Strong attention to detail, effective project and time management, focus on continuous improvement, and a pulse on regional market dynamics will be necessary for success in this role. 

If this sounds like you and you want to be part of a marketing team focused on growing Apple’s advertising business, we’d like to hear from you!

Writing project briefs and plans to support go-to-market activities.
Developing sales enablement materials and tailoring messaging (e.g. presentations, email templates, customer leave behinds, joint business plans, etc.) for specific business opportunities.
Highlighting localization needs and managing validation.
Collaborating on strategy and activation plans for regional initiatives, including events
Evaluating and reporting on marketing impact.
Communicating to geographically distributed internal teams, and more.
Some travel will be required.

10+ years experience developing and activating revenue-driving B2B marketing initiatives and sales enablement materials — with track record of working well with senior sales executives and teams
Strong grasp of market dynamics across the Greater China Region, as well as familiarity with cultural and business nuances in other key export markets — including the Americas and EMEA. 
Deep understanding of the adtech landscape, performance marketing, and standard business metrics for the gaming vertical
Extraordinary written and verbal communication — both in English and Chinese
Adept at navigating through ambiguity to move marketing initiatives forward — from business insight to strategy to deliverable to measurement and optimization
Skilled at discussing and debating ideas in a collaborative way, leading through influence and driving focus, and maintaining positive cross-functional relationships as challenges arise

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Self-starter who consistently delivers excellent work
Experience working in a geographically distributed team
Manages multiple projects, priorities, and overlapping deadlines effectively and with ease
Possess unquestionable personal code of ethics and integrity

Apple-200688982.title: GEA Platform Specialist, Apple Ads, Greater China
Apple-200688982.description:
At Apple, we work every day to create products that enrich people’s lives. Our Apple Ads group makes it possible for people around the world to easily access informative and imaginative content on their devices while helping publishers and developers promote and monetize their work. Our technology and services power advertising in the App Store, Apple News, Apple Maps and Apple TV. Our platforms are highly-performant, deployed at scale, and setting new standards for enabling effective advertising while protecting user privacy. Launched in 2016, Apple Advertising is an easy, efficient and fast-growing platform for app discovery. Apple Ads is becoming the app promotion platform of choice for iOS developers. Apple is a place where extraordinary people gravitate in order to do their best work.

If you are excited by the idea of making a real impact, and joining a team where we pride ourselves in being one of the most diverse and inclusive companies in the world, a career with Apple might be your dream job. Apple is redefining advertising on mobile devices while reaching hundreds of millions of iPhone and iPad users around the world. Through Apple Ads, advertisers and publishers get access to the most engaged consumers in the market. We’re looking for a Platform Specialist with demonstrated success to join the Global Enterprise Accounts team in our Apple Ads business.

The Platform Specialist team is essential to the business success, combining their abilities of analyzing data, optimizing accounts and articulating this in clear and simple terms with clients directly. With a focus on driving client growth and delivering best-in-class customer service, you'll have a hands-on, client-facing account management role with direct and agency customers in the Global Enterprise Accounts Team. The Platform Specialist is responsible and accountable for owning, growing and developing our key, global accounts. You will own and grow your accounts through making recommendations to clients on how to best optimize their campaigns to hit their business goals, while also forging long-term partnerships both in person and virtually. You will work closely with Client Partners who act as our frontline business development team. You will also partner closely with cross functional teams such as marketing and product, delivering back market sentiment on our products. You will be part of an inclusive and open team culture, with results focused behaviors that ensure the business hits its revenue and customer satisfaction targets.
Apple-200688982.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
3-7+ years experience in performance media sales, with at least 2-3 years experience using a self-serve type platform (IC3: 3-5+ years; IC4: 5-7+ years).
Strong understanding of advertising, the mobile and app market and a passion for the ever-changing digital space.
Strategic selling proficiency with enterprise advertisers and their agencies, building strong client relationships and a thorough understanding of their business objectives, goals and challenges to solve complex, open-ended business problems.
Fluent in English and Mandarin is a must.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Ability to think strategically about complex issues, apply critical thinking and best practices to develop tailored recommendations.
Passionate about working across teams, driving a culture of collaboration and shared success.
Excellent communication and presentation skills - in-person with travel, on video conference, and over-the-phone. Ability to listen effectively, socialize ideas across functions and articulate business visions both internally and externally. 
Ability to build a strong narrative with a thorough background and knowledge of Keynote. 
Identify and develop data analysis and recommendations that align with customer goals. Quantify high-impact opportunities with clear recommendations to pitch and upsell to customers. 
In-depth knowledge of Excel and comfort using AI tools to improve efficiency and quality of output.
Educate clients on Apple Ads’ solutions and provide consultative support on their media, measurement, and creative strategy to grow existing partnerships.
Ability to focus on details and trends, combined with the skills to react fast and ensure delivery of best-in-class customer service for advertisers.
Extremely professional, maintains a positive attitude and is passionate about working across teams, driving a culture of collaboration and shared success.
Ability to work, be accountable and communicate clearly across multiple time zones.

Lead various Retail Operations programs from concept through implementation, driving operational strategy and performance across retail locations. This includes customer experience strategies, new product introductions, training processes, Repair Room initiatives, and Warranty Fraud programs.

Apple-200688129.title: Global Navigation Satellite System Evaluation & Field Test Intern - Shanghai
Apple-200688129.description:
Apple is a place where extraordinary people gather to do their best work. Just be ready to dream big.

The people here at Apple don’t just build products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that encourages the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading customer experiences. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, great ideas have a way of becoming wonderful products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there’s no telling what you could accomplish.

Be a part of the Field Design Engineering (FDE) team!

As a Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) Evaluation & Field Test Intern, you will be on the front lines of testing and validating our location services. 

In this role, you will help us design and evaluate the next-generation location technologies powering future Apple products. You will combine high-precision GNSS and sensor fusion theory with rigorous real-world field evaluations to analyze performance and uncover critical user-experience gaps.

Field Testing & Ground Truth: Designing and executing real-world field tests using tactical-grade reference systems (e.g., NovAtel SPAN, Oxford OXTS, U-blox) and RTK base stations to establish ground truth.
Performance Analysis: Evaluating GNSS and sensor fusion performance in challenging environments to identify edge-case failure modes and root causes.
Competitive Benchmarking: Conducting competitive tests against other devices and emerging technologies to analyze user-experience gaps.
Data Automation: Developing and enhancing Python-based tooling to automate the parsing, analysis, and visualization of massive GNSS telemetry and sensor logs.
Apple-200688129.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Currently enrolled in an M.S. or Ph.D. program in Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field, with knowledge of Geomatics / Geodesy, Navigation, GNSS.
Available to join internship for ~6 months full-time internship. Full-time employment opportunities may be considered upon successful completion of the internship. 
Solid theoretical foundation in GNSS principles (pseudorange, carrier phase, Doppler observables, atmospheric delays, and multi-constellation systems).
Strong understanding of high-precision positioning (RTK, DGNSS, PPP) and GNSS/INS integrated navigation (Kalman filtering / EKF principles and IMU error models).
Proficiency in Python for automated data parsing, telemetry analysis, and scientific computing (e.g., Pandas, NumPy).
Hands-on experience working with raw positioning data formats (e.g., RINEX, NMEA-0183, Android GnssMeasurement, or binary GNSS/INS logs).

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Prior experience capturing, analyzing, or configuring raw GNSS/Sensor logs on Android devices (via GnssLogger, ADB, or engineering tools).
Experience with tactical-grade reference systems (e.g., NovAtel SPAN, Oxford OXTS,U-blox) or RTK base stations for field ground truth collection.
Familiarity with C++ for high-performance algorithm verification or test automation tooling.
Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for uncovering edge-case failure modes in consumer mobile devices.

Apple is a place where extraordinary people come together to do their best work. Imagine what you could achieve here. Apple-200683365.title: Head of Creative Services & Production
Apple-200683365.description:
Marketing Communications (Marcom)  is the creatively-led global team that oversees Apple’s consumer facing marketing. We ensure the flawless development and execution of world-class communications across all medias and platforms. Every day, hundreds of millions of Apple customers around the world interact with our products. We drive the strategy and creative work that provide both new and existing customers with simple, engaging and inspiring marketing experiences.

The Creative Services and Production (CS&P) team is made up of specialists across Creative Resource Management, Project Management and Production for print, digital and motion. The team are responsible for the planning, resourcing and management of the creative process, along with the production and delivery to the approved creative intent.

We are looking for a seasoned, highly capable Head of Creative Service & Production to be the main driver of creative production excellence by overseeing production capabilities, creative resources and project management. 

The Head of CS&P leads the individuals and teams that ensure the project work is planned, resourced and executed to the highest quality within the required timeframes and budgets.

In this role, you will be accountable for oversight and leadership of, or deeper engagement in, the following workstreams and responsibilities: Creative Resourcing and Capacity Management, Creative Services, Production Expertise, Financial & Production Operations Strategy, and Global Integration & Alignment.

Creative Resourcing & Capacity Management
A critical partner to the Geo Creative Director in managing the creative resourcing and project workflow.
Lead Creative Resourcing against the Marcom project roadmap to ensure appropriate resourcing plans are in place in a timely manner, partner with either the Geo or central Creative Resource Manager, and Geo Integrated PM, to maintain proactive oversight of updates and changes
Collaborate with Brand & Functional Leads and Integrated Project Management to develop an overarching roadmap annually and then by quarter against which resources can be planned and allocated
Cultivate a network of locally based creative talent (for example but not limited to Designers, Writers, UX Design, Interactive Visual Design, Production Design

Creative Services
Lead and manage the Integrated Project Manager/Team to plan Marcom’s project roadmap for the year and by quarter to identify potential resourcing and capacity challenges ahead of time.
Provide executive oversight of end-to-end creative workflows, empowering project management teams to optimize roadmaps, streamline localization, and mitigate high-level roadblocks.
Previous experience of creative services leadership in an agency or brand creative marketing space is a hugely beneficial.

Production Expertise
Lead and manage the Integrated Production teams who drive the day-to-day production and delivery of both NPI localisation and origination projects
Champion Geo original work for their respective region by directing the production/content leads responsible for high-end asset creation (CG, photography, video etc) whilst building on strategic vendor partnerships
Solid expertise in asset production across print production, static and motion production is a must, and ideally some experience in social film production, in order to effectively support and develop the talent within the local Production team
Ability to navigate a highly matrixed organisation and manage multiple stakeholders in order to guide the production team in quickly solving budget/timeline challenges while striving to fulfil the creative ambition is essential
Cultivate a network of locally based creative production talent/agencies, sharing information on their capabilities and performance with global CS&P community.

Financial & Production Operations Strategy
Work closely with the Ops Lead as a key partner, drive departmental efficiency by overseeing production budgets, operational forecasting, and the implementation of scalable tools and best practices across their Geo/s

Global Integration & Alignment
Act as the senior liaison between their Geo, other Geos and Worldwide (WW) leadership, orchestrating high-level feedback loops and ensuring local best practice dovetails seamlessly align with global business objectives
Collaborate with WW & Central Production leadership in supporting Production and CS initiatives, particularly those centred on new technologies and innovating for efficiency
Share local insights on pilots or new initiatives that ladder up to efficiency and quality goals with the global community
Ensure the appropriate Marcom/Apple governance and standards are adhered to across the CS & Production disciplines

A demonstrated track record of supporting a department that includes various Creative Services and/or Production functions (eg Project Management, Image Production, Motion Production) with hands-on experience of making the work
8+ years of leading and developing teams
Experience overseeing production budgets and operational forecasting.
Experience in asset production across print, static, and motion.
Experience navigating matrixed organizations and managing multiple stakeholders to solve budget and timeline challenges.

Highly demonstrated project management skills including stakeholder and process management, scope and budget planning and tracking
Experience in social film production.
Experience cultivating networks of local creative and production talent, including designers, writers, and production specialists.

Apple-200688687.description:
Imagine what you could do here! At Apple, new insights have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. 
The people here at Apple don’t just build products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. Join Apple and help us leave the world better than we found it. 
The In Region EE HW Engineer, you will work on the next generation Home & beats innovative products. You will be part of an extraordinary EE team, acting as the team’s local representation at manufacturing sites in China.

The role involves working with manufacturing teams and RD colleagues to design, validate and optimize hardware circuits and systems on home & beats products from first prototype build to mass production, requiring proactive multi-functional collaboration with other engineering groups such as other EE teams, FW, production test, ME teams etc. 
Define and implement validation plans for HW Sub-system such as power, DC-DC, I2C, USB, SPI, DDR etc. Debug and tackle hardware and interfaces. Make our excellent products even better!

Apple-200682641.description:

Apple-200693334.title: Homelabs R&D Team Leader
Apple-200693334.description:
Apple is looking for a versatile R&D Team Lead to guide a multidisciplinary engineering team in exploring new concepts and bringing innovative ideas to life through hands-on prototyping. This role combines technical leadership, project execution, and close collaboration with teams and technology partners around the world.
You will bring a broad understanding of complex technical systems, practical engineering experience, and the ability to connect people and ideas across disciplines. You will help the team turn open-ended challenges into clear priorities, working prototypes, and compelling demonstrations that inform future technology directions.

As a R&D Team Lead, you will guide day-to-day engineering activities, coordinate project delivery, and build effective relationships with vendors and internal partners. You will work closely with hardware, software, AI, design, and program management teams to define objectives, align technical requirements, and drive progress from early exploration through integrated demonstrations.

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring sound technical judgment across hardware and software, the ability to navigate system-level tradeoffs, and a willingness to contribute directly to prototyping, integration, and debugging. You will draw on the expertise of specialists while helping the team make decisions and resolve challenges across disciplinary boundaries.

The role involves domestic and international travel to vendor sites and Apple offices for technical reviews, collaborative development, integration activities, and project planning.

Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary tech, sensing, robotics team, establish clear priorities and ownership, and encourage open communication and collaborative problem-solving.
Translate exploratory goals into actionable project plans, with defined requirements, milestones, deliverables, and success criteria.
Coordinate schedules, resources, dependencies, and technical risks across parallel efforts; identify obstacles early and drive timely resolution.
Lead technical engagement with component vendors, technology partners, and research organizations, including capability assessments, requirements alignment, development reviews, and validation of deliverables.
Partner with teams across Apple to align technical direction, coordinate integration, and ensure prototypes address shared project and experience goals.
Guide system architecture and component selection, balancing performance, integration complexity, development time, and project needs.
Contribute directly to prototype development, system integration, testing, and debugging, working alongside engineers to resolve hardware and software issues.
Communicate project status, technical findings, tradeoffs, and decisions clearly to engineering teams, partners, and leadership.
Track emerging technologies and identify opportunities to accelerate development through external partnerships and new technical approaches.
Apple-200693334.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, Mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of relevant engineering experience, including hands-on development, integration, and testing of complex electromechanical systems.
Demonstrated experience leading engineering teams or multidisciplinary technical projects, with responsibility for coordinating work and delivering results.
Broad working knowledge of robotics hardware and software, including how mechanisms, actuators, sensors, controls, and software interact at the system level.
Practical ability to investigate technical issues, evaluate engineering tradeoffs, and contribute to prototyping and debugging.
Experience working directly with vendors or external engineering partners on technical requirements and development deliverables.
Strong project management, communication, and collaboration skills, including written and verbal English communication for global teamwork.
Experience in operating in large organizations with multiple stakeholders.
Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience guiding early-stage technology exploration where requirements evolve through experimentation and prototyping.
Experience coordinating geographically distributed teams and external partners across time zones.
A track record of mentoring engineers and building a collaborative, accountable team environment.
Experience evaluating components, platforms, and suppliers, and translating vendor capabilities into practical development plans.
Experience presenting integrated prototypes and communicating technical recommendations to diverse audiences.

Apple-200677312.title: IS&T Retail Senior Manager, China
Apple-200677312.description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization.  IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.

Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.

Retail and Marcom Engineering, an IS&T team, builds and operates the systems and experiences that connect Apple's products with its customers. The team owns the technology behind both Apple's online and physical stores and drives the interactive marketing experiences and tools that keep creative operations moving. Together, those functions deliver the technology behind every product story Apple tells and every purchase a customer makes.

As the IS&T Retail Senior Manager, China, you will hold a senior leadership role within APAC Retail Engineering, accountable for the overall technology execution, operational excellence, and organizational leadership of Apple Retail IS&T in China. You will provide end-to-end leadership for the China Retail technology organization, driving the successful delivery and operation of business-critical platforms that enable Apple's Retail business while ensuring alignment with APAC and worldwide IS&T strategies. Your success will be measured not only by technology delivery but by business outcomes, compliance, operational resilience, organizational capability, and long-term platform sustainability. 

You will lead a multi-disciplinary organization comprising Engineering Program Management, Retail Application Engineering, Quality Engineering & Test Automation, and Retail Engineering Operations. In this role, you will define organizational priorities, develop leadership capability, allocate investments and resources, and build a high-performing engineering organization capable of delivering at scale. You will operate within a highly matrixed global environment where success depends on executive influence, trusted partnerships, sound judgment, and the ability to align multiple organizations toward common IS&T and business objectives. 

Lead and evolve the Apple IS&T Retail China organization, providing strategic direction across Engineering Program Management, Application Development, Quality Engineering, and Engineering Operations.

Own the China Retail technology portfolio, ensuring investments, priorities, and execution remain aligned with business strategy and application lifecycle management.

Serve as the primary technology partner to Apple Retail China leadership, influencing strategic decisions and resolving dependencies across APAC and Worldwide IS&T organizations.

Build an inclusive, high-performing organization by attracting, developing, and retaining exceptional talent, while coaching managers and technical leaders.

Establish operational discipline across engineering support delivery, software quality, production stability, service management, and engineering effectiveness.

Lead large-scale, business-critical initiatives spanning multiple organizations, balancing priorities, managing organizational change, and optimizing business value.

Ensure technology solutions meet enterprise standards for security, China regulatory compliance, scalability, operational resilience, and customer experience.

Proven background in leading a multi-disciplinary technology organization, including Engineering Program Management, Application Development, Quality Engineering, and Operations.

Expertise operating in a highly matrixed global environment, successfully aligning cross-functional priorities without direct authority.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Deep understanding of the Retail technology landscape and business operations.
Proficiency in driving operational excellence through automation, scalable engineering practices, and data-driven decision making.

Strong foundation in organizational planning, workforce strategy, succession planning, and leadership development.

Exceptional executive communication skills required to build trusted partnerships with business executives and senior IS&T leaders.

Track record of owning a complex technology portfolio encompassing application lifecycle management, release management, and production operations.

Demonstrated ability to ensure technology solutions meet enterprise standards for security, scalability, and regional regulatory compliance.

Apple’s Environment, Social & Community Innovation team is seeking an operationally driven, intellectually curious Industrial Hygiene Technical Program Manager to join our team. We are looking for an energetic program architect—someone who thrives in undefined territory, looks beyond static standard operating procedures, and sees the immense potential to create a lasting, broader impact across our global manufacturing footprint and the wider industry.

You'll be hands-on from day one, managing the contractors and Third-Party Assessors (TPAs) who run our audits, because that closeness to day-to-day operations is what earns you the insight to build what comes next. From there, you'll design the decision rules and governance frameworks that let internal teams, TPAs, and suppliers execute at world-class standards. You'll bridge technical exposure science with high-volume factory realities, represent Apple's thinking in front of the broader industry, and help set the benchmark that the rest of the sector works toward.

As our Industrial Hygiene Technical Program Manager, you will identify opportunities to develop chemical management programs and convert them into structured, scalable initiatives with clear ownership, milestones, and measurable outcomes. You will drive deep technical discussions with Engineering and Operations teams, toxicologists, supplier leadership, and partner teams to embed industrial hygiene principles directly into new material qualifications, establish global manufacturing chemical management programs, and direct phase-out roadmaps for targeted classes of chemicals.

Critically, this role is designed to architect programs that scale. Rather than managing routine audits or checking off static compliance lists, you will design the systems, clear go/no-go decision rules, and governance frameworks that empower internal teams, Third-Party Assessors (TPAs) and suppliers to execute at world-class standards. You will bridge technical exposure science and high-volume factory realities, ensuring Apple’s chemical safety leadership continues to set the benchmark across the global manufacturing landscape.

Architect and scale chemical management initiatives across the global supply chain, turning complex priorities into structured roadmaps with measurable outcomes.
Identify systemic chemical exposure risks in non-routine operations (NPI builds, line maintenance), establishing engineering-control models and clear executive scorecards.
Partner with Engineering and Operations teams and toxicologists to embed industrial hygiene gates and exposure criteria into new material qualification workflows.
Establish the global standards and decision rights that let facilities and suppliers self-govern chemical specifications, VOC limits, and handling requirements.
Direct Third-Party Assessor (TPA) partners and manage technical vendor scopes of work to deliver high-integrity field exposure assessments and audits.
Represent Apple in industry coalitions and standards forums, advancing chemical safety practices that benefit broader manufacturing sector, not just Apple’s supply chain.
Apple-200688713.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Occupational Health & Safety, Public Health, Safety Engineering, Environmental Science, or a related technical discipline.
5+ years of direct technical experience in industrial hygiene, occupational chemical exposure assessment, or chemical safety within manufacturing or technical consulting.
Proven track record leading technical programs, taking undefined challenges, and converting them into structured, executed initiatives.
Demonstrated experience managing technical vendors, consulting firms, or Third-Party Assessors (TPAs).
Professional fluency in English and Mandarin (written and spoken) to lead technical engagements across global teams and regional suppliers.
Ability and willingness to travel regionally (30-50%) across APAC manufacturing facilities, with periodic international travel.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Master’s degree in Industrial Hygiene, Occupational Health, Public Health, or Chemical Engineering; Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) or Certified Safety Professional (CSP) credential strongly preferred.
Direct experience integrating chemical safety or industrial hygiene gates into New Product Introduction (NPI) or engineering material qualifications.
Familiarity with consumer electronics manufacturing (FATP/components) and process chemistries (solvents, cleaners, adhesives, inks).
Experience architecting chemical policies, restricted substances phase-outs, or hazard screening tools (e.g., GreenScreen®, ChemFORWARD, EPA Safer Choice).
Systems thinker comfortable making sound technical decisions and driving progress with incomplete information in fast-paced operational environments. - 
Familiarity or active participation in industry coalitions or standards bodies

Apple-200598147.title: Intern Opportunities at Apple (General) - October 2026 to September 2027
Apple-200598147.description:
Apple is a place where extraordinary people gather to do their best work. Just be ready to dream big.

The people here at Apple don’t just build products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that encourages the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

Imaging what you could do here. At Apple, creative ideas have a way of becoming wonderful products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there’s no telling what you could accomplish.

Multiple teams in Apple are looking for interns for FY27 (Oct 2026 to Sep 2027), including Apple Greater China R&D, Asia Procurement & Operations, Finance, Ads Platforms etc. 

Welcome to join us! If there're any opportunities match your skills and experience, we will contact you.

Location: Shanghai, Beijing, Shenzhen, Chengdu, Suzhou etc.
