Students who are not yet graduated are eligible for intern roles.

Clear communication with diverse teams, excellent written skill. For some intern roles, English proficiency is required.

Great interpersonal skill and team work.

Good at dealing with ambiguities and problem solving.

Solid understanding/ knowledge in your study/ research field.

Bachelor/ Master/ MBA /PhD in all majors including Finance/ Computer Science/ Software/ AIML/ Electrical Engineering/ Electronics Related/ Maths/ Data Science/ Physics/ Chemistry/ Materials/ Mechanical Engineering/ Mechanics/ Automation or other.

Apple-200686507.title: Java Backend Engineer - Retail
Apple-200686507.description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.  Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.  
Retail and Marcom Engineering, an IS&T team, builds and operates the systems and experiences that connect Apple's products with its customers. The team owns the technology behind both Apple's online and physical stores and drives the interactive marketing experiences and tools that keep creative operations moving. Together, those functions deliver the technology behind every product story Apple tells and every purchase a customer makes.

You will join a global engineering team delivering state-of-the-art technical solutions that power Apple’s retail and marketing ecosystem. Working with modern services, frameworks, and cloud tools, you will design and build complex, multi-tier enterprise applications across the full software development lifecycle. You will bring a collaborative, forward-thinking mindset to challenge the status quo, influence development processes, and shape future technical visions.

Design, build, and maintain scalable, multi-tier distributed enterprise applications powering Apple's online, physical retail, and marketing platforms.
Architect high-availability RESTful APIs and backend services utilizing the enterprise Java ecosystem and cloud paradigms.
Collaborate with global cross-functional engineering teams to deliver end-to-end technical solutions across the entire software development life cycle.
Implement robust data storage and retrieval strategies integrating relational and NoSQL database technologies.
Drive continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) practices using Git, Maven, and Gradle to streamline deployment pipelines.
Influence engineering standards and challenge the status quo to define future architectural visions and improve development processes.
Apple-200686507.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or equivalent practical industry experience.
Demonstrated experience in designing and developing multi-tier, distributed enterprise applications for high-volume environments.
Deep proficiency in Java, with an in-depth understanding of object-oriented design and the enterprise Java ecosystem.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Background building, deploying, and orchestrating highly scalable microservices using Containerization (Kubernetes/Docker) in public cloud environments (preferably AWS).
Hands-on experience designing RESTful APIs and integrating relational or NoSQL database technologies.
Solid understanding of enterprise architecture patterns (high availability, load balancing, replication), cloud paradigms (AWS/GCP), and CI/CD tools (Git, Maven, Gradle).
Outstanding communication and collaborative skills with a proven track record of contributing to cross-functional engineering teams.
Mastery of Clean Code principles, Test-Driven Development (TDD), Agile development methodologies, and DevOps practices.
Exposure to GraphQL and modern API architectural paradigms.

Apple-200682110.title: Korea App Store Producer
Apple-200682110.description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something. 

The App Store is the world's largest and most innovative software store, serving hundreds of millions of iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Vision Pro and Mac customers worldwide. We have an exciting opportunity for a Producer to join the team and support creative content production. We are looking for someone with excellent communication, collaboration and project management skills to join our team. You will play a key role in how users engage with the daily content available on App Store.

As an App Store Producer, you sit at the heart of our platform, collaborating with cross-functional teams to bring editorial features to life across the Today, Apps, and Games tabs. You will navigate complex technical environments, understand system impacts, and communicate these nuances to diverse teams. Operating in a fast-paced environment, you will maintain an unwavering focus on detail while driving high-profile projects to meet demanding deadlines. By owning the production process and schedule, you ensure every feature reflects Apple's standard of excellence.

Drive the day-to-day production of App Store content by managing processes, schedules, and cross-functional alignment.
Identify, track, and manage production for In-App-Event, partnering with regional colleagues to deliver key priorities for the Korea market.
Anticipate project roadblocks, escalate issues, and implement solutions to keep deliverables on track.
Synthesise complex technical instructions to assess system impacts and communicate findings to cross-functional partners.
Adapt and formulate production processes to support business needs and continuously improve project workflows.
Apple-200682110.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
2+ years of relevant experience in content production.
Fluency in Korean and English.
Meticulous attention to detail with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Experience in project management or production, focusing on clarifying deliverables, aligning teams, and driving results.
Experience navigating ambiguity, synthesising information, and making decisions. 
Proficiency with production workflow tools, such as Airtable and Miro.
Knowledge of App Store ecosystem and services.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience in programming or building custom tools to enhance production workflows.
Experience applying content judgment and facilitation skills with cross-functional teams.
Experience managing projects in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines.
Passion for technology, apps, and games, with a strong grasp of Apple platforms and user experience.
Proactive problem-solver who thrives in fast-paced, detail-oriented environments.
A strong curiosity and interest in exploring new technologies, creative tools, and emerging industry trends.

Apple-200694009.title: Live Streaming Program Operations Manager
Apple-200694009.description:
Imagine what you could do here! The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. At Apple, inclusion is a shared responsibility, and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.

The Apple Store Online team’s main goal is to deliver a magical, personal digital experience where customers can shop, buy and learn everything Apple, wherever they are. Each customer should feel like they are our only customer, and our job is to set the bar for the experience they receive. To create such an extraordinary experience, it takes extraordinary people, and we are looking for someone to help us do extraordinary things.

Our livestream program brings together content, commerce, and technology to create compelling customer experiences. We’re looking for an experienced Program Operations Manager who can drive complex cross-functional initiatives, bring structure to ambiguity, and build the operational capabilities to support the program’s next stage of growth.

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with strong executional capabilities, demonstrates sound judgment and ownership, and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic, highly collaborative environment.

As a Live Streaming Program Operations Manager, you will lead operational strategy, planning, and execution across our livestream program — driving initiatives across business, production, and technical teams to ensure alignment, readiness, and successful delivery. You will identify opportunities to improve processes and strengthen operational capabilities, while navigating organizational complexity and influencing stakeholders across functions to get things done.

Operational Leadership and Execution: Lead complex, cross-functional operational initiatives from strategy and planning through execution and delivery. Establish clear priorities, milestones, ownership, and accountability to drive measurable outcomes.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Drive alignment across business, production, technical, and external partner teams. Manage competing priorities and dependencies, and proactively resolve issues to maintain momentum and deliver results.
Livestream Operational Readiness: Own operational planning and readiness across livestream campaigns, special sessions, and studio operations, coordinating resources, production requirements, technical capabilities, and operational support.
Technical Solutions: Partner with technical, production, and platform teams to optimize livestream capabilities and ensure the readiness and reliability of technical solutions and infrastructure.
Operational Excellence and Scalability: Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, address operational gaps, and establish scalable processes, tools, and operating models that improve execution and the overall effectiveness of the livestream program.
Partner and Resource Management: Coordinate operational partnerships, resource planning, and financial processes — including contracts, procurement, and budget tracking — to ensure effective resource utilization.
Risk Management and Stakeholder Communication: Anticipate and proactively address operational risks, dependencies, and execution challenges. Provide leadership and stakeholders with clear visibility into progress, critical issues, and decisions required to drive initiatives forward.

Apple-200677867.title: Manager, Payment Acceptance -- China
Apple-200677867.description:
Join Apple, one of the most influential technology companies in the world. Be part of the Apple Finance organization and contribute to a company renowned for its innovative products, including Mac, iPhone, iPad, and the App Store. At Apple, you will partner with world-class teams driven by one unified vision -- creating products and experiences that delight customers. We hire individuals with integrity, accountability, teamwork, and a proactive mindset.

As a key member of the Payment Acceptance team within Treasury, you will manage drive the expansion and scaling of Apple's payment technology and infrastructure across APAC with our payment partners. You will play a pivotal role in payments strategy and contribute to high-profile initiatives across the region and lead the development of payment solutions that support how Apple sells its products and services -- online, in retail stores, and through the App Store. This cross-functional role is focused on building localized, scalable, and compliant payment solutions for Apple.

Define and drive Apple's long-term payments strategy in region, identifying emerging opportunities across payment instruments, channels, and technologies to position Apple at the forefront of a rapidly evolving payments landscape.

Lead the evaluation, management, and strategic prioritization of payment instruments -- developing compelling business cases and co-creating multi-year roadmaps with key external partners.

Act as the internal authority in region, advising senior leadership and cross-functional teams on market developments, regulatory shifts, and their strategic implications for Apple's business.

Spearhead high-impact, cross-functional initiatives in partnership with IS&T, business stakeholders, and strategic vendors, ensuring seamless execution of payments priorities from concept through delivery.

Champion a best-in-class control environment across payment operations, ensuring robust PCI compliance and proactive alignment with local data security and regulatory requirements.

Leverage deep data analysis and market intelligence to uncover strategic cost optimization opportunities, driving meaningful reductions in payment fees while enhancing overall payment performance.

Lead complex commercial negotiations with wallets providers, banks, payment networks, and processors in close collaboration with Apple Corporate Counsel, securing agreements that reflect Apple's scale and strategic objectives.

Cultivate and steward executive-level relationships with networks, domestic banks, licensed third-party payment institutions, and payment processors, positioning Apple in the market.

Establish and continuously elevate the rigor of payment cost analytics, driving a culture of financial discipline and ongoing fee optimization across all payment channels.

Define and monitor key payment performance metrics, translating data insights into strategic recommendations that enhance scalability, efficiency, and customer experience.

Serve as Apple's strategic radar on regulatory landscape -- proactively monitoring policy developments including payment rules, ensuring business leaders are equipped to respond with agility and confidence.
Apple-200677867.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Education: BS/BA degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field required.

8+ years of progressive experience in payments, with deep expertise in acquiring, bank payments, and third-party payment institutions.

Authoritative knowledge of payment regulatory framework, including PBOC regulations, cross-border payment policies, and licensing requirements -- with the ability to translate regulatory complexity into actionable business strategy.

Established relationships and proven experience working at a senior level with network, domestic payment wallets and banking partners.

Demonstrated track record of building and managing high-value strategic partnerships and driving business development outcomes at scale.

Exceptional leadership presence, with the grit and bias for action required to drive results in a complex, fast-moving environment.

Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, lead through complexity, and make high-quality decisions at pace.

Outstanding executive communication and influencing skills, with the credibility to engage senior stakeholders across cultures, functions, and geographies.

Excellent project management discipline, with strong written and oral communication skills in both Mandarin and English.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
MBA strongly preferred;

Demonstrated ability to set strategic priorities, operate with a high degree of autonomy, and deliver results across multiple high-stakes initiatives simultaneously.

Apple-200684372.title: Manager, Technology Compliance, Greater China
Apple-200684372.description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.

Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.

Business Operations, Employee Engagement, and Strategy is part of IS&T and shapes the strategy, operations, and culture of IS&T. The team oversees business planning, IS&T’s partnership strategy across Apple, and the technology tools that support the organization’s day-to-day operations. This team also leads IS&T’s enterprise generative AI strategy and manages compliance across systems. Through its communications and employee programs, it champions the growth, inclusion, and development of everyone in IS&T and drives the standard for IS&T brand and product communications across Apple.

Apple's IS&T Greater China Compliance organization is seeking a Manager in Shanghai to lead our compliance team in China and own the compliance posture of solutions running in-country. This is a broad remit spanning privacy, financial, payment, and information security regimes — including Compliance, SOX, PCI DSS, MLPS, and other applicable Chinese and global requirements — across a complex enterprise technology landscape.

You will define how IS&T demonstrates compliance for in-country systems: designing the programs, standing up the controls, evidence, and monitoring that operate them, and hiring and developing the team that delivers them. Privacy and personal information protection are a significant part of this remit, but not the whole of it — you'll be equally comfortable reasoning about financial reporting controls, cardholder data environments, and information security grading and filing obligations.

This is a hands-on leadership role, and it carries the technical and business depth of a senior individual contributor in addition to people leadership. At Apple, managers are expected to be in the details: reading the regulation, reviewing the assessment, sitting in the design review, and querying the data themselves. You'll set direction and remove obstacles for your team, and you'll also do the work alongside them — because credibility with engineering partners is earned through technical depth, not org charts.

You will partner closely with the US-based IS&T Security, Privacy, and Compliance team, as well as individuals in Legal, Privacy, Information Security, Internal Audit, Finance, Engineering, and other organizations to establish a coordinated, risk-based approach to identifying, assessing, governing, and monitoring in-scope systems and processing activities. You'll also partner closely with a peer compliance team in the United States, sharing methodology, tooling, and lessons learned so that both regions operate to a consistent standard while meeting the distinct requirements of their jurisdictions. You'll bring the rigor of an auditor, the discipline of a program leader, and the technical depth to propose and reason about data platforms, pipelines, and data at scale.

Strategy: Define the multi-year compliance strategy and roadmap for IS&T solutions in China across Compliance, SOX, PCI DSS, MLPS, and other applicable regimes. Anticipate emerging regulatory obligations, assess their impact on Apple's systems and data, and shape the organization's response before requirements land.
Program design: Architect compliance programs from first principles — control frameworks, assessment methodologies, evidence and testing approaches, governance forums, intake and escalation paths, and the metrics that prove they work. Where obligations overlap across regimes, design a common control set once and map it to many, rather than running parallel programs.
Build and lead the team: Define the team's shape and hire against it, growing a group of compliance professionals in China from the ground up. Set a high bar for analytical rigor and written clarity, establish career paths, give direct feedback, and create the conditions for people to do the best work of their careers.
Privacy and personal information protection: Own IST compliance for in-country solutions — governance of high-risk personal information processing, privacy assessments, data subject rights enablement, and cross-border data transfer requirements.
Stay in the details: Personally review assessments, findings, control designs, evidence packages, and reporting. Engage directly in technical design reviews and regulatory analysis. Maintain enough hands-on fluency with the data and systems to validate your team's conclusions and to be a credible partner to engineering leaders.
Design review and control fit: Evaluate proposed architectures, data flows, and technical designs to assess their fit with control objectives — identifying where a design satisfies requirements, where it falls short, and what alternatives would meet the objective more efficiently. Engage engineering teams early, so controls are built in rather than retrofitted.
Requirements translation: Partner with Legal, Privacy, and Internal Audit to convert regulatory obligations and internal policy into practical, testable control requirements and repeatable operating processes.
Audit and assessment readiness: Own readiness for internal and external audits, assessments, and regulatory filings affecting in-country solutions. Coordinate with auditors and assessors, manage evidence collection, and drive findings to closure.
Risk governance and accountability: Own the risk picture for solutions running in China. Drive findings and commitments to closure, escalate with clarity, and hold owners across the organization accountable for outcomes.
Monitoring and reporting: Establish monitoring, metrics, and dashboards that give engineering leaders and executives a clear, honest view of compliance posture and emerging risk. Present to senior leadership in China and globally, and translate technical detail into decisions.
Cross-functional and cross-region leadership: Build strong relationships within China, with the sister compliance team in the United States, and with Apple's global functions and partner organizations. Bridge in-country requirements and global standards, drive alignment across time zones, and foster a unified approach to program goals.
Enablement and advocacy: Champion adoption of compliance platforms, tooling, and standards across the organization. Lead education and awareness initiatives in partnership with engineering teams.

Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.

Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.

Business Operations, Employee Engagement, and Strategy is part of IS&T and shapes the strategy, operations, and culture of IS&T. The team oversees business planning, IS&T’s partnership strategy across Apple, and the technology tools that support the organization’s day-to-day operations. This team also leads IS&T’s enterprise generative AI strategy and manages compliance across systems. Through its communications and employee programs, it champions the growth, inclusion, and development of everyone in IS&T and drives the standard for IS&T brand and product communications across Apple.

Apple's IS&T Greater China Compliance organization is seeking a Manager in Shanghai to lead our compliance team in China and own the compliance posture of solutions running in-country. This is a broad remit spanning privacy, financial, payment, and information security regimes — including Compliance, SOX, PCI DSS, MLPS, and other applicable Chinese and global requirements — across a complex enterprise technology landscape.

You will define how IS&T demonstrates compliance for in-country systems: designing the programs, standing up the controls, evidence, and monitoring that operate them, and hiring and developing the team that delivers them. Privacy and personal information protection are a significant part of this remit, but not the whole of it — you'll be equally comfortable reasoning about financial reporting controls, cardholder data environments, and information security grading and filing obligations.

This is a hands-on leadership role, and it carries the technical and business depth of a senior individual contributor in addition to people leadership. At Apple, managers are expected to be in the details: reading the regulation, reviewing the assessment, sitting in the design review, and querying the data themselves. You'll set direction and remove obstacles for your team, and you'll also do the work alongside them — because credibility with engineering partners is earned through technical depth, not org charts.

You will partner closely with the US-based IS&T Security, Privacy, and Compliance team, as well as individuals in Legal, Privacy, Information Security, Internal Audit, Finance, Engineering, and other organizations to establish a coordinated, risk-based approach to identifying, assessing, governing, and monitoring in-scope systems and processing activities. You'll also partner closely with a peer compliance team in the United States, sharing methodology, tooling, and lessons learned so that both regions operate to a consistent standard while meeting the distinct requirements of their jurisdictions. You'll bring the rigor of an auditor, the discipline of a program leader, and the technical depth to propose and reason about data platforms, pipelines, and data at scale.

Strategy: Define the multi-year compliance strategy and roadmap for IS&T solutions in China across Compliance, SOX, PCI DSS, MLPS, and other applicable regimes. Anticipate emerging regulatory obligations, assess their impact on Apple's systems and data, and shape the organization's response before requirements land.
Program design: Architect compliance programs from first principles — control frameworks, assessment methodologies, evidence and testing approaches, governance forums, intake and escalation paths, and the metrics that prove they work. Where obligations overlap across regimes, design a common control set once and map it to many, rather than running parallel programs.
Build and lead the team: Define the team's shape and hire against it, growing a group of compliance professionals in China from the ground up. Set a high bar for analytical rigor and written clarity, establish career paths, give direct feedback, and create the conditions for people to do the best work of their careers.
Privacy and personal information protection: Own IST compliance for in-country solutions — governance of high-risk personal information processing, privacy assessments, data subject rights enablement, and cross-border data transfer requirements.
Stay in the details: Personally review assessments, findings, control designs, evidence packages, and reporting. Engage directly in technical design reviews and regulatory analysis. Maintain enough hands-on fluency with the data and systems to validate your team's conclusions and to be a credible partner to engineering leaders.
Design review and control fit: Evaluate proposed architectures, data flows, and technical designs to assess their fit with control objectives — identifying where a design satisfies requirements, where it falls short, and what alternatives would meet the objective more efficiently. Engage engineering teams early, so controls are built in rather than retrofitted.
Requirements translation: Partner with Legal, Privacy, and Internal Audit to convert regulatory obligations and internal policy into practical, testable control requirements and repeatable operating processes.
Audit and assessment readiness: Own readiness for internal and external audits, assessments, and regulatory filings affecting in-country solutions. Coordinate with auditors and assessors, manage evidence collection, and drive findings to closure.
Risk governance and accountability: Own the risk picture for solutions running in China. Drive findings and commitments to closure, escalate with clarity, and hold owners across the organization accountable for outcomes.
Monitoring and reporting: Establish monitoring, metrics, and dashboards that give engineering leaders and executives a clear, honest view of compliance posture and emerging risk. Present to senior leadership in China and globally, and translate technical detail into decisions.
Cross-functional and cross-region leadership: Build strong relationships within China, with the sister compliance team in the United States, and with Apple's global functions and partner organizations. Bridge in-country requirements and global standards, drive alignment across time zones, and foster a unified approach to program goals.
Enablement and advocacy: Champion adoption of compliance platforms, tooling, and standards across the organization. Lead education and awareness initiatives in partnership with engineering teams.

Apple-200662065.title: Manager/Senior Manager, Commercial Legal - Retail and Online Stores
Apple-200662065.description:
Apple’s Commercial Legal Group is seeking a Manager/Senior Manager, Retail & Online, to lead a team of attorneys supporting Apple’s APAC direct channel business, including Apple’s physical brick-and-mortar Apple Retail Stores, Apple’s Online Stores, Retail Customer Care Centers, and its community of 88,000+ retail field team members.  

In this role, you will work closely with senior legal and business leaders and colleagues across Apple to help Apple Retail achieve its business objectives. You will be a trusted partner to senior leaders by distilling complex, cross-functional inputs into streamlined narratives, priorities, and actionable guidance. You will constantly be shifting gears, day-to-day, as a trusted advisor across a variety of legal and business issues, and serve as a critical liaison to other Apple lines of business and legal teams as an expert in the inner workings of Apple’s Retail organization. You will manage a team of attorneys that oversee the legal issues relating to Apple’s APAC retail businesses. Your role will require you to think strategically about Apple’s go-to-market strategies and advise on a diverse range of legal, operational, and PR issues around consumer protection, sales practices, marketing, data privacy, consumer safety, accessibility, and more. You will be expected to proactively advocate for, influence, and implement strategies, partner cross-functionally across legal and Apple-wide teams, and manage outside counsel.  

• Lead the APAC legal team supporting Apple’s direct retail business, including business teams supporting platform partnership, operations, commercial programs, technology development, insights & analytics, services integration, marketing, merchandising, Genius Bar service and support, field/store support, retail security, internal communications, learning and development, and related expansion efforts.  
• Develop and execute go-to-market initiatives globally for future products, sales and demo platforms, and internally-developed hardware and software products and solutions utilized by Retail’s employees and customers.  
• Manage regulatory and PR risk via collaboration with cross-functional Apple-wide partners, including, Government Affairs, PR, Regulatory, Global Security, Marketing, Operations, and LGS (litigation, HR, product, IP, services, marketing, and privacy teams).  
•  Exercises sound judgment in escalating issues, anticipating leadership needs, simplifying complexity, and framing information to drive clarity and alignment. 
• Mentor and develop team members spanning junior to senior levels.
Apple-200662065.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Attorney with 15+ years of professional in-house or international law firm (or combined) legal experience with a high level of expertise in high-tech industry and/or premier retail industry. 
Bachelor of Laws (LLB), or equivalent degree
Admission to a country with well-established common law or civil law system 

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
3+ years in a leadership role managing other attorneys and/or other legal professionals 
Juris Doctor or equivalent degree 
Experience leading cross-border legal initiatives
Significant product counseling experience

Experience leading complex commercial partnership negotiations
Strategic thinker with the ability to effectively balance risk management and business initiatives in high-stakes, fast-paced environments
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to advise and build relationships with leaders, teammates, and cross-functional colleagues
Insightful analytical skills and strategic business sense with the ability to resolve complex issues in thoughtful, collaborative, and effective ways.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to coordinate and manage a high volume of complex projects in a fast-paced dynamic environment
Experience managing regulatory inquiries/investigations
Significant experience deftly handling sensitive matters and interpersonal conflict, escalation, and resolution.
Comfort managing outside counsel to ensure efficient use of funds
Exemplary judgment and integrity

Apple-200685023.title: Materials Program Manager
Apple-200685023.description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something.

As a Materials Program Manager, you are the strategic driver at the core of our supply chain operation, focused on ensuring Apple's products successfully reach our customers.  You will own the material strategy for a product line, making critical decisions across key domains: supply planning and readiness, strategic allocation and constrain management, financial risk and liability projection,  and executive communication.

Specific responsibilities include, but not limited to: 
Supply Intelligence & Clear-to-Build (CTB): Own and drive the CTB strategy, providing clear visibility and decisive leadership on material status for the product line, lead contract manufactures and Apple cross-functional teams to resolve all material constraints, including multi-tier supply chain challenges.

Strategic Allocation & Optimization: Lead the allocation of constrained components across line of business, making the critical trade-off decisions to maximize value and align with product priorities. Drive the development and implementation of advanced optimization models to deliver actionable intelligence for supply planning.

Executive Communication: Translate complex material scenarios into clear and concise executive summaries. Deliver high-impact communications to senior management that distill data-rich insights and drive critical business decisions.

Supply Chain Network: Architect and optimize the supply chain & material network to meet product schedule and supply strategy. Drive the creation of advanced models to enhance network and lead time, ensuring a resilient and efficient supply chain.

New Product Material Readiness: Orchestrate end-to-end material readiness for New Product Introductions (NPI). Proactively mitigate supply chain risks by influencing x-functional teams and design decisions, and own the resolution of all NPI material issues from identification through closure.

Lifecycle & Transition Management: Own the material strategy for product transitions and End-of-Life (EOL). Drive key business decisions to minimize Excess & Obsolete (E&O) liability, and command the claims process to ensure timely financial closure.
Apple-200685023.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
BS/BA degree or higher in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.

A proven ability to deliver results in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

Exceptional problem-solving, communication, and analytical skills.

A strong curiosity and drive to optimize the end-to-end supply chain.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
A strong learning agility and a track record of driving cross-functional excellence.

Demonstrated ability to deconstruct complex situations, architect innovative solutions, and command an executive audience.

Experience leveraging AI/ML concepts and data tools to contribute to the strategy and implementation of data-driven business transformations.

Experience translating business needs into effective process solutions and collaborating on system and tool design.

Apple-200690330.title: Module NPI OPM Intern
Apple-200690330.description:
Imagine what you could do here! At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. The people here at Apple don’t just build products — they craft the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

New Product Operations is pivotal to the dynamic development and launch of Apple’s products. A successful NPI OPM Intern is a natural facilitator; is driven, organized and detail-oriented; has a strong interest in program/project management; communicates with ease at all levels; thrives in an ambiguous environment; is adept at facilitating actions; leads through relationships and influence; and displays grace under fire.

You will support the NPI development, factory & equipment bring-up, program management, core process, quality teams and other functional organizations within Apple. You will assist the team in driving the successful launch of the product towards meeting its stated schedule, quality, equipment availability and customer experience. Successful candidates will have the following attributes: exceptional ability to establish relationships; clear, consistent communication; data-driven and willing to take action; enthusiastic and motivated; and detail-oriented while supporting several work streams.
Apple-200690330.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree program (Engineering, Supply Chain or related fields),  MBA is a plus
Available for a full-time internship for at least 6 months.
Strong communication skills and fluent English.
Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in data tools (e.g., Excel).

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Prior internship or project experience in New Product Introduction / Supply Chain Management / Manufacturing Operations / Engineering / Project Management.
Ability to succeed in a matrixed environment.
Exceptional ability to build relationships; data-driven and willing to take action; enthusiastic and motivated; and detailed while managing several work streams.
Ability to work in a highly ambiguous, fast-paced environment.
Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functionally without authority.
Ability to travel to manufacturing sites as needed.
Knowledge of data analysis, Tableau, Python, or machine learning would be a plus.

- Lead the operational side of development builds during new product introductions for any assigned products.  
- Lead Apple team's new product introduction efforts during ramp within the Operations sphere. Specific goals include team leadership in driving issue resolution, supply chain design, schedule, cost, quality, availability and order cycle time goals.  
- Engage with OEM manufacturing partners to develop, ramp, and introduce products. Develop rapport with partners and detailed knowledge of "how the factory works," its capabilities and limitations.  
- Lead matrix team members from across all functions in Asia within Operations to develop new product plans. Typical functions include WW Planning, Global Supply Managers, Technical Program Manager, Quality, Supplier Quality Engineer, Test Engineer, Design For Manufacturing.  - Represent operations with the product design teams. Use production expertise to influence and negotiate for DFX, supply chain, testability, product features.  
- Identify, marshall and organize resources (Apple Staff, OEM Staff, Contractors, etc) to meet required goals.  
- Communicate project status updates to various project partners, including team members and executives within Apple and OEMs. Synthesize a multitude of issues into a clear, concise and focused message. Present with confidence and brevity.  
- Always push the leading edge of innovation and excellence in Apple products and program management practices.  
- Support coverage in other products in the region. Travel to another location on other products on an as-needed basis to drive issue resolution and/or support build/ramp activities.

The Regional Operations New Product Manager leads all aspects of new product development and product launch within Operations in Asia and is directly accountable for the results. Responsibilities include achieving goals for time to market, cost, quality, product availability and order cycle time. The New Product Manager in region is the primary leader and interface between Operations, Product Design, Engineering teams.

Current knowledge of extraordinary supply chain management practices.

Exceptional ability to establish relationships and exert effective influence in a matrix organization.

Attention to detail without becoming lost in the details.
Operate in an ambiguous environment, taking charge in the absence of leadership.

Apple-200681422.title: Noise & Vibration Internship
Apple-200681422.description:
At Apple, new ideas have a way of quickly becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences. Sound is an essential and compelling face of the customer experience so Apple has assembled a world-class Acoustics team that enables our customers to experience music with delight, communicate with clarity, and appreciate our products without disturbance from noise. In Apple Acoustics we work with obsessive attention to detail, directly contributing to products that ship to millions of people around the world.

The China noise & vibration intern is directly working on design and implementation of test methodologies to eliminate unwanted acoustic noise. Communication with design as well as cross-functional teams in other countries will be critical. The candidate will work on a specific project on noise & vibration reduction for industry-leading consumer electronic devices.

As part of Apple’s Noise & Vibration group, the N&V intern will be based in Shanghai and will have responsibilities including:
• Implementing and writing test plans and standard operating procedures for acoustic testing in lab environments
• Analyzing data using noise level and sound quality metrics
• Create and implement innovative noise and test solutions with cross-functional teams
• Some travel among sites in Shanghai and Shenzhen regions

MS/PHD or equivalent, preferably last year student specializing in Acoustics / Mechanics / EE
Major in acoustic or vibration with electronics relevant experience
Fluent in English & Mandarin and technical concepts in English & Mandarin
Strong theoretical and experimental background in acoustics & vibration, or magnetic interaction.
Solid testing and data analysis skills

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience with acoustic testing equipment (chambers, microphones, etc)
Comfortable with MATLAB, Python, and ability to learn new scripting skills
Ability to effectively contribute in fast-paced, constantly changing, multitasking environment
Flexibility in problem solving approaches

Apple-200686504.title: Operations Engineer, Retail Store Operations & Support
Apple-200686504.description:
The people here at Apple don’t just build products — we craft the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that supports the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts.Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.  

IS&T Retail Store Apps Engineering is responsible for the technology and IT systems used to enable Apple Retail Stores to service millions of customers enabling Apple Retail to become one of the best retailers in the world. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.  

Do you enjoy solving complex business problems with process and technology? Do you thrive in environments that require multi-functional thinking, collaboration, and innovation? If so, this may be the job for you.

This is a hands-on engineering role with high visibility across Apple's global retail technology landscape and an opportunity to shape how production support operates at scale.

As an Operations Engineer on the transactional operations vertical, you will own deep technical expertise across some of Apple Retail's most critical systems, including Point of Sale, Apple Financial Services, Carrier Services, Runner, and Catalog. You will combine that domain expertise with hands-on troubleshooting, building and extending GenAI agents, screening tools, and automation that fundamentally change how our team detects, investigates, and resolves issues.

You will partner closely with Engineering, SRE, and business teams to drive root cause analysis, deliver process improvements, and bring clarity to complex technical problems for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 
The ideal candidate is a proactive problem solver who thrives in a fast-moving production environment and is energized by production environments where speed, scale, and precision all matter, who codes when needed, and who communicates with precision across audiences. If you are passionate about supporting reliable, high-impact systems that serve millions of customers worldwide, this may be the perfect opportunity for you. 

In this role, you will:

Build and extend GenAI agents, automation that scale incident detection, triage, and resolution across the team.

Develop deep technical ownership of transactional systems (Point Of Sale, Apple Financial Services, Carrier Services, Runner, Catalog) to investigate, debug, and resolve complex production incidents with speed and precision.

Lead root cause analysis using application logs, telemetry, observability platforms, and ML-driven insights, partnering with engineering and leadership to prioritize and drive resolution.

Contribute to the design and development of functional requirements, technical specifications, and support documentation for automation and process improvement initiatives.

Partner cross-functionally with engineering teams, business stakeholders, to enhance product delivery, support strategy for new launches, and continuous improvement of service quality.

Coordinate with our globally distributed team of consultants to ensure consistent execution of support functions.

Participate in an on-call rotation to support critical applications and services, which may include infrequent non-standard hours and weekend coverage.
Apple-200686504.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
2+ years of experience supporting critical, customer-facing systems in a high-volume production environment.
1+ years of hands-on experience with incident management platforms (e.g. ServiceNow) and issue tracking tools (e.g. Jira).
2+ years of practical experience with Splunk, including dashboard creation, SPL querying, and alert configuration for production triage, performance degradation analysis, and incident resolution.
2+ years of experience performing structured root cause analysis using application logs, telemetry, distributed traces, and customer feedback across complex, multi-system environments.
Fluency in both Mandarin Chinese and English.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Hands-on experience building and orchestrating agentic workflows with SOTA language models, LLM-based automation, or AI-augmented operational tooling.
Demonstrated ability to work across distributed systems, APIs, and microservices at an architectural level - understanding how failures propagate across system boundaries.
Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/TLS, load balancing) with the ability to diagnose connectivity issues between distributed systems.
Strong root cause analysis skills using diverse data sources including application logs, telemetry, and customer feedback.
Experience with frequently used scripting languages (Python preferred) for log analysis, data investigation, and lightweight automation of operational workflows.
Excellent ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience coordinating with distributed teams across multiple time zones in addition to strong cross-functional collaboration skills.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git-based version control, and release management/deployment processes.
Experience with data visualization and analysis tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
Proficiency in ITIL practices, including incident, problem, and change management.
Experience validating data feeds between SAP (MM, SD, FI) and downstream retail systems, with the ability to identify and troubleshoot discrepancies in inventory, pricing, and order data.
Previous experience supporting eCommerce platforms or Retail / Payment systems at scale in a plus.

Apple-200671855.title: Optics Metrology Lead
Apple-200671855.description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other's ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It's the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we
can do the best work of our lives. Here, you'll do more than join something — you'll add something.

At Apple, innovation comes from individuals working together to build products that transform how people live, create, and communicate. Our Camera & Depth Space organization plays a pivotal role in maintaining product standards, ensuring our customers are consistently impressed and delighted by the quality of our products. We are seeking a Metrology System Design Lead to drive the architecture, system engineering requirements specification, design, and development of our instrumentation in parallel with the core technology. In this role, you will lead the design of comprehensive and customized metrology systems that are instrumental in the development of cutting-edge technologies for our products, while leading cross-functional teams across Apple and key business partners.

As a Metrology System Design Lead, you will own and lead the end-to-end architecture, design, and implementation of calibration and test systems for one or more technologies, from early prototypes through mass production. This role requires a natural leader with a profound understanding of firmware and hardware fundamentals and a background in designing complex systems, who thrives in dynamic and fast-paced environments. You will serve as the primary contact for metrology system engineering requirements, scalable validation, and processes for core technologies, acting as the key liaison between our organization and internal and external cross-functional engineering teams to ensure the timely and accurate implementation of metrology solutions that meet engineering specifications.

Own and lead the architecture, design, and implementation of calibration and test systems for one or more technologies, from early prototypes to mass production
Specify instrumentation and diagnostics for validating product performance
Specify and implement process control and data collection
Demonstrate dynamic and flexible adaptability to switch between diﬀerent projects across various technologies
Calibration & Test Development
Lead members of our organization in developing instruments, algorithms, fixtures, infrastructure, diagnostic software, and scalable processes to validate and test technologies throughout the development supply chain across Apple and key business partners
Collaborate closely with development teams during early stages of technology development to define validation criteria for functionalities and performance
Document metrology development and execution project plans
Cross-Functional Leadership & Program Management
Serve as the primary contact for metrology system engineering requirements, scalable validation, and processes for core technologies
Interact with internal groups at Apple to ensure metrology solutions are executed and engineering specifications are met on time Communicate the progress of metrology solutions and their readiness to executives, upper management, and technical staﬀ
Navigate a dynamic and rapidly evolving environment, making sound decisions with ambiguous information

Excellent understanding of hardware/firmware architecture and the interoperability of complex systems
Prior experience with one or more of the following technologies: camera, depth sensing, and EE (e.g., SoC, image sensor, power, signal integrity, battery)
Experience with technologies involved in mobile devices. Ability to collect, analyze, and present data to senior management

Prior technical leadership and/or project management experience.

Apple-200688701.title: Partnership Manager
Apple-200688701.description:
Apps enrich people’s lives, driven by developers dedicated to creating extraordinary experiences that delight customers. Apple’s Worldwide Developer Relations team (WWDR) provides the services, resources and guidance that empower the world’s most dynamic developer community to push the boundaries of innovation and bring the next big app ideas to Apple’s platforms for customers worldwide. WWDR also offers programs to help developers connect with experts, learn about the latest Apple tools and technologies, and adopt best practices to supercharge app development.

Join the WWDR team for Greater China and work directly with developers in this vibrant region to deliver compelling app and game experiences. You will collaborate with developers, communities, and internal stakeholders to lead initiatives that help creators deliver magical experiences across Apple’s platforms. This role involves shaping future opportunities and defining unique regional requirements for upcoming products and services.

Collaborate with strategic developers, communities, and internal stakeholders to lead initiatives that deliver AI-powered solutions and experiences across Apple platforms.
Partner with developers to bring their innovations to Mac, iPad, iPhone, and Apple Watch by understanding their roadmaps and influencing senior leadership.
Discover and incubate new developers alongside Apple teams to deliver outstanding AI-powered solutions and experiences for the regional and global market.
Develop and execute go-to-market strategies, providing market insights and leadership to unlock opportunities aligned with business priorities.
Define and communicate regional requirements for current and future products to global cross-functional stakeholders.

Ability to focus and deliver in a dynamic, creative, and fast-paced environment.

Apple-200684786.title: Platform Specialist Manager, Industry, Apple Ads, Strategic Sales, Greater China
Apple-200684786.description:
At Apple, we work every day to create products that enrich people’s lives. We want to help people in every part of their lives that we can, including making the world’s best content easily and beautifully available to the hundreds of millions of people around the globe who use Apple products. Apple is a place where extraordinary people gravitate in order to do their best work.

Our Apple Ads group makes it possible for people around the world to easily access informative and imaginative content on their devices while helping publishers and developers promote and monetize their work. Our technology and services power advertising in the App Store, Apple News, and Apple TV. Our platforms are highly-performant, deployed at scale, and setting new standards for enabling effective advertising while protecting user privacy. Launched in 2016, Apple Ads is an easy, efficient and fast-growing platform for app discovery. Apple Ads is becoming the app promotion platform of choice for iOS developers. 

In this role, you will grow and lead a team that is responsible for managing, optimizing and developing our largest accounts. Critically the team will have a clear focus on both customer satisfaction and revenue targets. You’ll use your knowledge of developers, advertisers and agencies to create and maintain positive and productive relationships with marketers of all sizes and types. This team is essential in supporting the growth of our largest accounts and helping them achieve success.

You’ll quickly gain the respect and support of both management and other employees by achieving business goals and demonstrating good judgment, commercial acumen, balance, objectivity, collaboration, quiet confidence, and trustworthiness. You will also have direct management responsibility for a team of Platform Specialists.

Reporting directly to the regional Head of Platform Specialist Managers (PSMs), partnering closely with the Head of Industry on a subset of vertical business strategies and operations for strategic customers. 
Management of a Platform Specialist Team responsible for managing, growing, and developing our strategic accounts. You will lead and develop this team while remaining hands-on with our largest customers.
Driving the right sales culture under the regional Platform Specialist organization’s strategy, ensuring we achieve revenue targets and other key performance metrics (e.g., incentive programs, OKRs). Leading by example to deliver extraordinary service to all customers.
Ensuring the team reports their business accurately through our CRM system and other internal business management tools.
Partnering closely and efficiently with the Client Partner team to build an optimal working relationship that delivers the best experience for our customers.
Working with multiple cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Measurement and Data Insights, and Sales Enablement and Operations, to feed back market sentiment on our products.
In short, this is an incredibly exciting opportunity to lead the Platform Specialist team focusing on the Industry vertical at Apple. This team is critical to our business success and must be able to combine deep data analysis, compelling narrative building, and account optimization with the ability to lead client meetings at the senior level.
Apple-200684786.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Experience in account management operations or other client-facing sales and service functions.
Proven management experience leading highly successful teams, ideally in digital account management within Greater China.
Significant work experience and a high level of credibility in online, digital, or performance marketing, ideally within the mobile advertising sector.
Deep understanding of the mobile market in Greater China, especially mainland China (both domestic and export), and a keen passion to learn in the ever-changing digital space.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to listen effectively, socialize ideas across different functions, and articulate business visions both internally and externally.
Strong commercial acumen with a focus on detail and trends, combined with the aptitude to adapt and react quickly to deliver best-in-market service to our clients.
Ability to collaborate with the Client Partner team in selling to C-suite customers while also understanding and optimizing data at the account level.
Experience working with cross-functional teams to drive a culture of collaboration and shared success.
Strong organizational skills, keeping the team focused on critical business priorities while maintaining the ability to step back and see the bigger picture.
Proven passion for developing teams and driving an inclusive culture of collaboration. Ability to motivate, inspire, and guide others toward achieving shared goals.
Proficiency in both Mandarin and English.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience and demonstrated success in building excellent team cultures: coaching, developing, and retaining talent, and guiding teams through transitions and organizational changes.
Deep knowledge of relevant verticals (Entertainment, Finance, Productivity & Utilities, etc.) with strong experience managing clients and sales teams. 
Possess a growth mindset, highly collaborative, and resilient. Track record of success and outstanding achievement.
Master's degree is a plus.

Apple-200684065.title: Privacy Compliance Analyst
Apple-200684065.description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.

Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.
Business Operations, Employee Engagement, and Strategy is part of IS&T and shapes the strategy, operations, and culture of IS&T. The team oversees business planning, IS&T’s partnership strategy across Apple, and the technology tools that support the organization’s day-to-day operations. This team also leads IS&T’s enterprise generative AI strategy and manages compliance across systems. Through its communications and employee programs, it champions the growth, inclusion, and development of everyone in IS&T and drives the standard for IS&T brand and product communications across Apple.

Apple's IS&T Security, Privacy, and Compliance organization is seeking a Privacy Compliance Analyst to help establish and operate enterprise privacy and regulatory compliance programs across a complex, global technology landscape. In this role you will translate regulatory and policy requirements into scalable compliance processes, assess and govern privacy and data protection risk, and drive accountability for remediation across the organization.

You will partner with Legal, Privacy, Information Security, Engineering, Product, Data, and business teams — as well as regional in-country compliance teams — to establish a coordinated, risk-based approach for identifying, assessing, governing, and monitoring high-risk personal information processing activities. You'll bring the rigor of an auditor, the discipline of a program manager, and the technical depth to propose and reason about data platforms, pipelines, and data at scale.

Program operation: Help define, establish, and continuously improve privacy and regulatory compliance frameworks for IS&T, with a focus on efficiency, scalability, and robust reporting.
Requirements translation: Work with Legal and Privacy partners to convert regulatory obligations and internal policy into practical, testable control requirements and repeatable operating processes.
Risk and control assessment: Perform privacy assessments, control assessments, and compliance reviews of applications, data flows, and business processes. Identify gaps, quantify risk, and recommend pragmatic remediation.
Design review: Evaluate proposed architectures, data flows, and technical designs to assess their fit with control objectives — identifying where a design satisfies requirements, where it falls short, and what alternatives would meet the objective more efficiently. Partner with engineering teams early, so controls are built in rather than retrofitted.
Remediation accountability: Track findings and commitments to closure. Escalate with clarity, drive owners toward outcomes, and help remove obstacles to progress.
Monitoring and reporting: Build monitoring and reporting mechanisms — including data-driven metrics and dashboards — that give engineering leaders and executives a clear view of compliance posture and emerging risk.
Analysis at scale: Query and analyze large enterprise datasets to validate controls, test compliance assertions, and surface anomalies rather than relying on attestation alone.
Cross-functional partnership: Build strong relationships across IS&T and with regional compliance teams. Facilitate communication across divisions and foster a unified approach to program goals.
Enablement: Champion adoption of compliance platforms, tooling, and standards. Support education and awareness initiatives in partnership with engineering teams.
Apple-200684065.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
4+ years of experience in privacy, compliance, risk management, information security, technology audit, or data governance
Experience performing risk assessments, control assessments, privacy assessments, audits, or compliance reviews
Hands-on experience with global privacy and data protection regulations such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, Compliance, or other emerging global data protection regimes
Experience with data classification, data governance, data inventories, or data-flow mapping
Familiarity with cloud environments, enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, and software development life cycle methodologies
Ability to evaluate technical designs and architectures against control objectives and articulate gaps to both engineering and non-technical audiences
Demonstrated ability to translate regulatory, policy, or control requirements into practical and scalable processes
Strong analytical skills and the ability to assess complex business and technical processes
Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders across technology, security, engineering, product, legal, and business teams
Experience managing multiple priorities and driving complex cross-functional initiatives to completion
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to frame complex concepts for senior audiences
Ability to work independently and operate effectively in an ambiguous, evolving regulatory environment
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Audit or advisory experience at a Big 4 or comparable professional services firm
Experience with Privacy Impact Assessments, Data Protection Impact Assessments, or similar risk assessment methodologies
Experience with cross-border data transfer governance
Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with Python and large-scale data ecosystems; comfort applying data science concepts to compliance monitoring
Proficiency with AI tools and techniques — using generative AI and ML-based agents to automate analytical and compliance workflows, accelerate assessment and evidence review, and expand monitoring capabilities at scale
Experience supporting technology compliance programs within a large, matrixed organization
Privacy, risk, audit, security, or compliance certifications (e.g., CIPP, CIPM, CIPT, CISA, CRISC)
Excellent presentation and storytelling skills

Apple-200682115.title: Product PR Lead
Apple-200682115.description:
The people here at Apple don’t just build products—they craft the kind of wonder that has revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.

Apple's Worldwide Communications team informs the world about our innovative products and services, and the values that drive everything we do. The team includes professionals with backgrounds in corporate communications strategy, journalism, media relations, buzz marketing, and event production. We’re looking for trailblazing, collaborative professionals from a variety of creative fields. If that’s you, then your next home may be here. Come and do the best and most exciting work of your career at Apple! 

The Greater China team develops and manages world-class communication strategies to support Apple’s continued growth in this dynamic region. We are seeking a Product PR Lead to drive the strategy, planning, team management and development and, execute programs and initiatives flawlessly with impactful results, and collaborate with relevant business functions to drive for Apple’s business success  in the region. This role will drive the development and implementation of a cutting edge product storytelling strategy to proactively communicate Apple’s product advantages to targeted media, influencers and stakeholders.

In this role, you will be leading a team of PR Managers who you will actively develop through nurturing and building capabilities tied to our competency architecture and leadership attributes.

This role will partner closely with WWPR to align on global initiatives and product messaging while also defining, planning and executing local initiatives with nuances to address Greater China specific insights. You will rely on your relationship-driven ability to work cross-functionally and cross-borders with WWPR  and local business functions including but not limited to Product Marketing, Marketing Communications, Buzz, Retail, Sales, to ensure communications plans are implemented locally.

The role will need to lead new product introductions by partnering closely with WW stakeholders and bring to life with relevance locally. During momentum, you will need to proactively design innovative programs and social forward storytelling to maintain the robust drumbeat of our products to expand the reach of audiences. 

This role is expected to be hands-on, working day-to-day with the team to build our product narrative and champion Apple’s innovation story.

In addition, you must have the capacity to handle crisis and other reactive PR situations with grace and ease, knowing when and how to respond to media inquiries. You will identify and escalate potential public issues that may impact Apple, diffuse rumors, and resolve conflicting messages.

The successful candidate will bring energy, ideas and an appetite to bring fresh storytelling ideas to fruition.
Lead the Greater China rollouts of hardware and software, devising and implementing communications initiatives that resonate with the local audience. Responsibilities will include strategic planning and execution, new product introduction planning and execution, actively participate in annual planning, and prioritizing the most relevant and meaningful news in a fast-paced environment and continuous news cycle.
Work collaboratively with a variety of other teams and functions to create and deliver activity that increases awareness and understanding. This will include Product Marketing, Marketing Communications, Buzz, Sales, Retail to drive for bigger opportunities and business success.
Demonstrate leadership with Apple quality. Manage, mentor, coach, and develop the team to deliver high impact results. Show up as a trustworthy and collaborative leader when working with other functions.
Have the know-how to manage a product related issues and crisis. Provide PR consul and guidance to business functions to address issues with satisfactory results.  
Find new relationships amongst the talent and communities that use our products and services to deliver the world’s most exciting work, and lead our efforts in finding new media, influencers and social platforms through which we can tell those stories.
Have your finger on the pulse of the constantly evolving media and social landscape in Greater China. Spot the opportunities that arise from these changes and recommend how we can capitalize on them to improve coverage.
Proactively build and maintain relationships with key media, resulting in maximum opportunity for results. Supervise and track key coverage for your market and share news with the wider Greater China and global teams when relevant.
Maintain a network of agency resources in the region as required to support the execution of local initiatives and programs.
Apple-200682115.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
15+ years of experience in a global organization in a consumer and/or corporate PR capacity;
Experience delivering public relations campaigns that create impact.
Experience managing change and ambiguity while leading teams and building interpersonal relationships.
Experience developing and delivering communications that convey a clear understanding of a product narrative to stakeholders. Ability to analyze complex information to solve problems and prioritize tasks in a dynamic environment.
Ability to continually prioritize and multi-task in a dynamic, creative, fast-paced environment.
Highly collaborative with extraordinary social and interpersonal relationship-building skills.
Proficiency in Mandarin and English.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience from Technology and/or Consumer Goods sectors.
Network of media, journalist contacts and high profile influencers in Greater China. 
Knowledge of social media platforms and digital media trends.

Apple-200680652.title: Product Solutions Analyst
Apple-200680652.description:
At Apple, we believe our most important resource is our people. We're looking for a skilled Product Manager to help shape the future of the technology that brings extraordinary people to Apple. This role will partner with business and engineering teams to design, build, and continuously improve tools that power how we attract, evaluate, and hire talent.

The ideal candidate brings a mix of product management expertise, recruiting technology domain knowledge, and strong cross-functional influence. You'll work at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, recruiting operations, and compliance to deliver scalable, user-friendly solutions for the China market, while contributing to and shaping the global recruiting technology roadmap as a member of a global team.

Partner with engineering and cross-functional teams to design, deliver, and continuously improve an Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and related internal recruiting technologies and integrations.
Translate recruiting business needs into clear product requirements that deliver operational excellence and compliance while creating an exceptional candidate experience.
Write clear and concise product definitions that capture the vision, goals, and key elements of new offerings.
Manage the full product lifecycle, from research and requirements gathering to launch, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
Represent China market needs and constraints within the global Recruiting Technology team's roadmap planning, ensuring local requirements are reflected in global product decisions.
Identify opportunities where solutions built for the China market, such as localization patterns, compliance workflows, or platform integrations, can be generalized or reused to benefit recruiting technology in other regions.
Anticipate and manage upstream and downstream dependencies across multiple systems and stakeholders.
Facilitate complex discussions by uncovering the "why" behind requests and driving decisions that balance business and technical tradeoffs.
Ensure recruiting processes and tools meet compliance requirements while delivering user-friendly, intuitive workflows.
Collaborate across time zones as part of a global team.
Apple-200680652.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
5+ years of HR technology product management or related experience, including hands-on delivery with engineering teams.
English, Mandarin fluency. Other language fluency a plus but not required. 
Experience in an in-house recruiting product or process role designing and implementing cross-system recruiting processes from design through delivery, including ongoing support and continuous improvement.
Demonstrated ability to contribute local expertise to shared global roadmap decisions rather than operating in a regional silo.
Strong ability to operate at multiple levels simultaneously, from defining long-term strategy to driving day-to-day execution details.
Track record of driving clarity and momentum in ambiguous situations, enabling quick, informed, data-centric tradeoff decisions.
Demonstrated ability to influence without authority, build consensus, and foster trust with stakeholders at every level, from executives to recruiters to engineers, operating with increasing independence as scope and ambiguity grow.
Excellent communication and presentation skills with varied stakeholders (executives, recruiters, hiring managers, engineering, operations, legal, privacy, etc.), including the ability to engage external vendors when needed.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Demonstrated experience supporting talent acquisition in Mainland China, including familiarity with local hiring practices, labor regulations, and candidate expectations.
Working knowledge of China data localization requirements as applied to HR/recruiting systems.
Strong analytical skills and ability to balance attention to detail with big-picture thinking.
Working experience in Agile development methodology.
