Partner with engineering and cross-functional teams to design, deliver, and continuously improve an Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and related internal recruiting technologies and integrations.
Translate recruiting business needs into clear product requirements that deliver operational excellence and compliance while creating an exceptional candidate experience.
Write clear and concise product definitions that capture the vision, goals, and key elements of new offerings.
Manage the full product lifecycle, from research and requirements gathering to launch, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
Represent China market needs and constraints within the global Recruiting Technology team's roadmap planning, ensuring local requirements are reflected in global product decisions.
Identify opportunities where solutions built for the China market, such as localization patterns, compliance workflows, or platform integrations, can be generalized or reused to benefit recruiting technology in other regions.
Anticipate and manage upstream and downstream dependencies across multiple systems and stakeholders.
Facilitate complex discussions by uncovering the "why" behind requests and driving decisions that balance business and technical tradeoffs.
Ensure recruiting processes and tools meet compliance requirements while delivering user-friendly, intuitive workflows.
Collaborate across time zones as part of a global team.

5+ years of HR technology product management or related experience, including hands-on delivery with engineering teams.
English, Mandarin fluency. Other language fluency a plus but not required. 
Experience in an in-house recruiting product or process role designing and implementing cross-system recruiting processes from design through delivery, including ongoing support and continuous improvement.
Demonstrated ability to contribute local expertise to shared global roadmap decisions rather than operating in a regional silo.
Strong ability to operate at multiple levels simultaneously, from defining long-term strategy to driving day-to-day execution details.
Track record of driving clarity and momentum in ambiguous situations, enabling quick, informed, data-centric tradeoff decisions.
Demonstrated ability to influence without authority, build consensus, and foster trust with stakeholders at every level, from executives to recruiters to engineers, operating with increasing independence as scope and ambiguity grow.
Excellent communication and presentation skills with varied stakeholders (executives, recruiters, hiring managers, engineering, operations, legal, privacy, etc.), including the ability to engage external vendors when needed.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Demonstrated experience supporting talent acquisition in Mainland China, including familiarity with local hiring practices, labor regulations, and candidate expectations.
Working knowledge of China data localization requirements as applied to HR/recruiting systems.
Strong analytical skills and ability to balance attention to detail with big-picture thinking.
Working experience in Agile development methodology.

Apple-200679152.title: Program Manager, Retail Customer Experience Survey System
Apple-200679152.description:
Imagine what you could do here! The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. At Apple, inclusion is a shared responsibility, and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.

The WW Apple Retail Engagement, Marketing & Merchandising (REMM) team defines, makes and delivers programs, campaigns, initiatives and experiences that help Apple Retail’s customers and teams discover, be inspired by, learn about and go further with Apple’s products and services, and does so in a manner that is true to our values.

Join Apple Retail's Customer Insights team as a Program Manager and be a driving force behind our customer feedback survey program operations. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for our NetPromoter Program survey infrastructure, leading innovative projects and developing system solutions, collaborating closely with technical and business partners, to keep our surveys in sync with the business as it evolves and ensure smooth daily operations. Your work supporting data and reporting systems will amplify the voice of the customer to thousands of team members and leaders, so that they can deeply understand customer journeys, measure the impact of critical business changes, and identify opportunities for improvement.

We're looking for a candidate who blends exceptional project management skills with strong technical acumen in systems architecture, a talent for creative problem-solving, and passion for Apple's customers and teams. They thrive on leading complex cross-functional initiatives, adeptly influencing stakeholders at all levels, and aligning diverse technical and business teams to achieve impactful results.

In this role, you will spearhead initiatives to build, optimize, and maintain the robust operational systems of our high-impact, high-visibility customer survey program. You will be instrumental in driving the overarching program infrastructure strategy, ensuring surveys are aligned to organizational goals with key partners, while expertly balancing strategic vision with hands-on project execution. Your contributions will directly enhance technological innovation within our daily operations.

The ideal candidate is a customer-focused, results-oriented leader with exceptional program and project management expertise. You possess the ability to communicate effectively across all levels, adeptly facilitate actions, resolve conflicts, and cultivate strong, collaborative relationships with diverse stakeholders. Your leadership style is characterized by influence and partnership, enabling you to drive outcomes effectively.

Key responsibilities include:

Strategic Project Management: Drive end-to-end project lifecycle, from conceptualization to successful implementation, translating business needs into precise requirements and ensuring on-time delivery, driving accountability for yourself and supporting partners.

System Optimization & Technical Insight: Monitor and optimize critical operational systems, drive issue resolution with technical teams, and explore new technologies to enhance system design and efficiency.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Cultivate robust relationships with diverse teams, acting as a trusted partner and championing accountability, high performance, and continuous improvement.

Impactful Communication: Ensure transparent, helpful, and proactive communication with all stakeholders, tailoring messages effectively, and fostering alignment and collaborative success.

Masterfully manage and prioritize a diverse portfolio of projects, ensuring efficient and effective simultaneous execution across varying scopes.
Coordinate all project details and task management with internal partners and external vendors, including creating comprehensive project plans, defining deliverables, establishing measurable success metrics, proactively identifying and mitigating risks, resolving roadblocks, and maintaining team focus and motivation.
Craft and maintain thorough documentation for system designs, technical specifications, data flows, and operational procedures, to establish clarity, facilitate knowledge transfer, and support long-term maintenance.
Conduct daily quality checks to support the ongoing operation of our survey programs, including survey sampling, data integrity, localization, reporting, and access controls.
Proactively investigate and drive to resolution all data flow or quality issues, demonstrating full ownership in identifying both immediate fixes and sustainable long-term solutions, and upholding the highest standards of data integrity.
Develop a deep understanding of complex system landscapes, actively contributing to technical and business requirements gathering, design reviews, and offering creative technical suggestions to engineering teams.
Collaborate intensively with business stakeholders, technical experts, vendors, market research analysts, and fellow program managers to optimize processes, enhance solutions, improve consistency, and foster continuous innovation.
Apple-200679152.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Exceptional project management, analytical, and coordination skills, with a dedication to operational excellence, quality, continuous improvement, and a willingness to challenge the status quo.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences and influence stakeholders at all levels.
Proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives end-to-end in fast-paced enterprise environments, with strong command of strategic planning, risk mitigation, stakeholder management, and on-time delivery.
Experience leading teams through both Waterfall and Agile project management methodologies, including primary ownership for creating effective project plans with detailed timelines and strong change management skills.
Demonstrated ability to understand, optimize, and troubleshoot operational systems, including creating technical requirements and driving design discussions — with strong problem-solving skills to navigate ambiguity, balance short-term urgency with long-term strategy, and drive clarity across cross-functional stakeholders.
Practical experience working with AI technologies, including large language models (LLMs) and generative AI tools, with demonstrated ability to evaluate and apply them in research operations, data workflows, or program management contexts.
Professional fluency in both Mandarin (Simplified Chinese) and English — written and verbal — required to effectively support and collaborate with teams across China and international markets.
Minimum of 7 years of project management or equivalent experience.
Bachelorʼs Degree or equivalent industry experience.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience working in a customer experience and/or retail function, ideally with multi-channel platforms (e-commerce, in-store, digital platforms).
Quantitative market research background is beneficial, particularly with international research and on the vendor side, bringing an understanding of diverse client needs and research methodologies.
Experience in system design, specifically orchestrating the integration and functionality of reporting tools and databases.
Working knowledge of (or willingness to learn) data querying languages (SQL, especially with Alibaba Cloud data warehouse solutions), data visualization tools (such as Tableau, Streamlit), and text analytics.
Ability to create diagrams and documentation describing complex relationships between systems and surveys (Miro, Figma, OmniGraffle, Visio).
Relevant certifications in project management, change management, and/or business analysis (such as PMP, PMI, Scrum, Six Sigma).

Apple-200681924.title: Project Manager, User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
Apple-200681924.description:
Imagine what you could do here! The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. At Apple, inclusion is a shared responsibility, and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.

Here on the Apple Store Online team, we are responsible for Apple’s largest store. Our main goal is to deliver a magical, personal digital experience where customers can shop, buy and learn everything Apple, wherever they are. Each customer should feel like they are our only customer and our job is to set the bar for the experience they receive. To run such an extraordinary store, it takes extraordinary people, and we are looking for someone to help us do extraordinary things.

Our UAT (User Acceptance Testing) Project Management team ensures that our online offerings work as designed and deliver the magical experiences we intend. This team understands our systems deeply and owns the functional and end-to-end testing lifecycle — creating test strategy and testing frameworks, mobilizing cross-functional teams from test planning through execution, and providing quality sign-off prior to project go-live. As a UAT Project Manager, you will direct and drive medium to large-sized UAT programs spanning both regional and global cross-functional teams, with direct impact on one of the world's largest e-commerce sites. This role places you in a highly energized environment alongside some of the most hardworking, creative individuals in the industry — where you'll be inspired to build on your years of experience while delivering extraordinary work with an amazing team!

You will manage, plan, and organize activities and tasks throughout UAT planning and execution, developing deep subject matter expertise in E2E customer journeys, business processes, and impacted systems.

In this role, you will:

Dynamically develop and drive comprehensive cross-functional UAT strategies.
Collaborate across multiple UAT partner teams, aligning efforts to drive cohesive outcomes.
Provide forward-thinking, goal-oriented direction through effective communication, even in the face of ambiguity.
Direct test resources required for successful project execution, while shaping UAT management processes in line with industry best practices.

Operating as the lead of an ASO functional track, or as the cross-functional lead of a larger UAT program, reporting into a centralized testing function.
Managing, planning, and organizing activities and tasks throughout UAT planning and execution.
Leading and collaborating with multiple UAT partner teams, aligning efforts across to drive success.
Leading test resources required for successful project execution, and providing input to processes that drive continuous improvement in line with industry best practices.
Reporting on progress, keeping the extended team informed, and ensuring accountability for resolving key issues.
Apple-200681924.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
4+ years in UAT/QA/Quality e-commerce (online/marketplaces) transactional testing and project management experience, navigating complex, integrated systems with aggressive timelines in both Waterfall and Agile landscapes.
A strong understanding of the SDLC, with UAT/QA/IT/Quality experience within an e-commerce or contact-center-based organization (e.g., user experience/web front-end, transactional back-end, or contact center applications).
Proficiency in test planning and scripting, managing test execution through sign-off.
Experience with manual and automation test strategies to drive test efficiency.
BA/BS degree in a business or technical field, or 8+ years of relevant professional experience.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
7+ years of professional experience in User Acceptance Testing (UAT), in a PM or lead capacity.
Experienced with AI/ML validations, test automation capabilities and test scripting processes.
An excellent communicator who sees around corners, identifies potential areas of concern, has a sense of urgency, and can rally teams to review and mitigate risk.
Quality-focused and deeply technical, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Exhibits a genuine passion for innovation, shown through creative strategies and continuous process improvement.
PMP Certification or SAP experience is a plus.

Dynamically develop and drive comprehensive cross-functional UAT strategies.

Direct test resources required for successful project execution, while shaping UAT management processes in line with industry best practices.

Apple-200681695.title: Quality Assurance Lead, Retail Technology
Apple-200681695.description:
Imagine what you could do here! The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. At Apple, inclusion is a shared responsibility, and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.

We’re a diverse collective of thinkers and doers, continuously reimagining our products and practices to help people do what they love in new ways. That innovation is inspired by a shared commitment to great work and to each other. Learning from our people here means we're learning from the best! The RDM team create and care for Apple Stores that look, feel, and function as beautifully as our products. We do this by obsessing over the employee and customer experience, and driving a global strategy that sets the bar.

The Retail Technology China team is responsible for the end-to-end digital app and hardware experience in Apple Retail China stores, including all aspects of the customer and employee experience. As a QA Lead on this team, you'll be an integral member of the implementation team alongside product management, business stakeholders, and development teams, ensuring our Retail applications satisfy the needs of the business and the end user across China's stores.

You'll manage the user acceptance testing (UAT) process to ensure the business receives acceptable software that supports business requirements, and support planning and execution of production validation testing (PVT) as systems release to end users. You'll accurately assess and quantify the business, technical, and regulatory risks associated with the software and systems being tested — including ensuring compliance with China's data privacy and security requirements — and analyze, plan, and communicate test strategies and progress to multiple constituencies. This role requires someone who can synthesize large amounts of complex information, pay attention to detail, and manage multiple concurrent initiatives.

Manage multinational teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) from Apple Retail Stores who execute tests designed and planned by the QA Lead, including tester recruitment, engagement, and day-to-day testing operations during UAT and PVT. Serve as a liaison between the Shanghai team and global/APAC stakeholders on China testing initiatives
Define, document, and communicate test plans and test cases — including automated test coverage — that thoroughly validate the product and reveal potential defects, based on requirement and design review sessions.  Assess and communicate product quality at key milestones to project leaders, development teams, and Retail leadership
Validate compliance with China's data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements as part of test planning and execution, partnering with Legal/Privacy and Engineering to close gaps.  Clearly document and track defects to engineering partners, striving for stability and quality across our retail systems
Advance test automation coverage and frameworks/tooling to improve release velocity and reduce regression risk.  Influence and direct project teams to follow standardized, defined processes, recognizing process-driven problems and taking corrective action

5+ years working directly with Retail-focused systems (e.g., Point of Sale, Inventory Management, Logistics, Help Desk, Customer Management, Customer Support)

Experience validating software against data privacy, security, or regulatory compliance requirements
Ability to work with minimal supervision and influence cross-functional team members. Detail-oriented with excellent communication and organizational skills; outstanding interpersonal skills.
Fluent in Mandarin and English

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Direct experience with China's data privacy and regulatory compliance landscape
Experience supporting peers on system deployments and business process re-engineering initiatives
Ability to function in a fast-paced environment, prioritize projects under deadlines, and change course based on business or environmental conditions
Demonstrated problem solving, time management, and analytical skills
Awareness of different software development models
Experience using AI-assisted tools for test generation, defect triage, or test management
Familiarity with SAP Retail systems
Experience working in the Retailing industry

Apple-200684386.title: Quality Program Manager, Retail Customer Care
Apple-200684386.description:
Imagine what you could do here! The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. At Apple, inclusion is a shared responsibility, and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work!

Here on the Apple Store Online team, we are responsible for Apple’s largest store. Our main goal is to deliver a magical, personal digital experience where customers can shop, buy and learn everything Apple, wherever they are. Each customer should feel like they are our only customer and our job is to set the bar for the experience they receive. To run such an extraordinary store, it takes extraordinary people, and we are looking for someone to help us do extraordinary things. 

The Retail Customer Care(RCC) Quality team is looking for a passionate and strategic individual who believes that the customer experience is at the heart of what we do and works tirelessly to help our teams achieve just that.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with regional and global Quality Program Managers, Retail Customer Care leadership and cross functional stakeholders to uphold the quality standards and elevate the customer experience.Through targeted contact review and strategic programs, you will identify key business trends and insights, leveraging them to craft a framework that guides the business in understanding what matters most to our customers and leadership in your region.

A Quality Program Manager will participate in weekly business reviews, responsible for quality analysis and reporting. You will regularly lead and participate in calibration activities, be an expert in quality standards and align the teams with these standards. You will also need a deep knowledge of the business, performance management and vendor management practices. It is important that you are able to articulate and analyze customer expectations and satisfaction, service trends and professional ethics and operational policies and procedures are followed.

A Quality Program Manager is responsible in supporting and guiding their respective sites and business partners to achieve goals in customer satisfaction and quality performance and includes building behavior based coaching plans based on qualitative and quantitative insights. This work will be achieved through influencing management, adopting best practices and effective root cause analysis on the reasons for customer dissatstifaction or lack of adherence to customer and business critical processes and practices. This is all done through the lens of quality. As one of multiple quality program managers for the region, you will also partner with your peers to set the direction and provide consistency across the network.
Apple-200684386.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Superb written and communication skills, including fluency in Cantonese, English, and Chinese
5+ years of experience in a quality management or program management role within a contact center, e-commerce or customer service environment
Ability to work with and influence cross functional business partners to create and achieve strategic quality objectives and goals
Adapt to changing environments, technology and processes
Drive for results with a high degree of determination 
Strict adherence to company policy on confidential materials
Makes space to listen, learn, and amplify diverse perspectives and experiences
Actively seeks out opportunities to champion and celebrate inclusion and diversity

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Strong data visualization skills with experience using tools like Tableau to identify trends and draw actionable conclusions
Proven track record in end-to-end customer journey design and leveraging AI capabilities to elevate customer experience
Excellent communication and presentation skills (written and verbal), with the ability to clearly communicate complex information to diverse audiences, including stakeholders at various levels
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to identify root causes and develop effective solutions
Proven track record in transactional quality assurance, utilizing methodologies like call scoring and audits, with knowledge of quality management frameworks (COPC, Six Sigma)
Proven ability to manage multiple projects concurrently, prioritize effectively and consistently meet deadlines in a fast paced environment
MBA is preferred

Apple-200693838.title: RF System Integration Manager
Apple-200693838.description:
The Apple System RF team is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Radio Frequency (RF) System Integration group. In this role, you will lead a talented team of engineers responsible for architecting, developing, and optimizing RF automation software and calibration/test systems across Apple’s product lineup—including iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Mac, and more.

At Apple, new insights have a way of becoming products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. You will guide a hands-on engineering team that furthers precision, creativity, and innovation across leading wireless technologies. We are looking for an inspiring technical leader who can shape long-term test and calibration strategy, mentor and grow exceptional engineers, and partner across hardware, firmware, and operations to deliver extraordinary products to billions of users. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.

Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of RF System Integration engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and accountability.
Drive the architecture, development, and continuous improvement of a multi-faceted C/C++ and Python RF automation software suite.
Oversee the design, validation, and optimization of RF calibration and testing algorithms across leading and emerging wireless standards.
Define technical roadmaps, manage resource allocation, and guide project execution from early concept and architecture through mass production.
Partner closely with cross-functional teams—including RF Hardware, Firmware, Silicon Validation, Operations, and EPMs—to resolve complex system-level RF issues and drive root-cause analysis.
Establish rigorous engineering processes, review key technical designs and statistical test data, and navigate schedule, quality, and performance trade-offs.
Communicate project status, technical risks, and strategic trade-offs clearly to executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
Apple-200693838.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience (MS/PhD preferred).
Proven experience managing, mentoring, or serving as a technical lead for hardware/software integration or RF engineering teams.
Strong software engineering background with proficiency in C/C++, Python, or similar languages for test automation and algorithm development.
Solid foundation in RF fundamentals, communications theory, RF metrics, and hardware impairments.
Hands-on familiarity with RF/Wireless lab equipment, test methodologies, and calibration systems.
Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Deep domain expertise in wireless protocols (e.g., Cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, NFC, UWB) with proven experience architecting advanced test systems and leveraging statistical data tools to drive technical strategy.
Demonstrated track record of building, mentoring, and scaling high-performing engineering teams while fostering accountability and technical excellence.
Proven ability to partner collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams—including Hardware, Firmware, Operations, and EPM—from early architecture through high-volume production.
Skilled at navigating competing priorities, resolving cross-functional trade-offs, and driving consensus under tight schedule and quality constraints.
Excellent communication and executive presence, with the ability to articulate complex technical trade-offs clearly and influence across organizational boundaries.

Apple-200688427.description:

Here on the Apple Store Online team, we are responsible for Apple’s largest store. Each customer should feel like they are our only customer and our job is to set the bar for the experience they receive. We are seeking an experienced and agile Readiness Senior Program Manager to drive contact centre readiness for these critical launches. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, excel at navigating complexity, and are passionate about both the customer and employee experience, this role is for you.

As a Readiness Senior Program Manager, you will be able to identify, define and drive contact centre readiness launch strategies, provide guidance to support Apple policies, and support an exceptional end-to-end customer experience. Your responsibilities will range from high-level strategic planning and stakeholder alignment to detailed execution tasks such as managing communication plans, overseeing operational command centers, and resolving launch-related issues.

Non-standard business hours and some travel will be required.

* Strategic Readiness Planning: Identify, define, and drive comprehensive contact centre readiness strategies for product, program, and promotional launches, ensuring alignment with Apple policies and customer experience goals.
* Operational Execution & Event Management: Coordinate and lead readiness efforts and on-site command centers during key launches, defining roles, managing escalations, and ensuring real-time issue resolution.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead and influence cross-functional partners (including ASO Readiness, Marketing, Operations, Engineering, Training, Communications) to ensure cohesive readiness planning and execution.
* Content & Communication: Simplify complex information for specialists and customers; oversee or create necessary communications, training inputs, and readiness documentation. Clearly communicate launch readiness status, risks, and opportunities across all organizational levels.
* Process Standardization & Improvement: Develop, implement, and continuously refine standardized readiness processes across all regions, leveraging KPIs and data analysis (launch performance, feedback, NPS, etc.) to measure success and drive data-driven improvements for enhanced efficiency and effectiveness.
* Relationship Building: Cultivate strong relationships both inside and outside of the organization to effectively influence outcomes and champion an exceptional launch and customer experience."

Excellent communication and presentation skills (written and verbal).
Bilingual in Chinese and English

10+ years of relevant experience in program management, project management, or launch readiness, ideally within a fast-paced tech or retail environment. Direct experience within a contact center environment and/or fulfillment operations.
Experience working with China e-commerce.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, navigate ambiguity, and gain consensus from stakeholders in sensitive situations.
Proven ability to operate effectively at a global scale, collaborating with international partners across different time zones and cultures.
Proactive, results-oriented team player with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and meticulous attention to detail with an obsessive focus on delivering exceptional customer and employee experiences.

Apple-200672886.title: Regulatory Program Manager
Apple-200672886.description:
Our ever-evolving suite of products are helping our users lead healthier lives. 
Be ready to make something great when you come here. Dynamic, inspiring people and innovative, industry-defining technologies are the norm at Apple. The people who work here have reinvented and defined entire industries with our products and services. The same dedication to innovation also applies to our approach to health, strengthening our commitment to leave the world better than we found it.

This role supports Apple's broader health initiatives within the medical device portfolio, directly contributing to our users' healthier lives worldwide. You will support our relationships across Apple's diverse internal teams, as well as regulators, clinical partners, and institutions across China and the APAC region. This work will drive regulatory and medical device policy efforts, strengthen regional clinical and scientific engagement, and enable global feature availability.

The Program Manager's responsibilities include providing comprehensive support for global medical device submissions, product launches, design changes, medical device policy interactions, and cross-regional health initiatives, with a focus in China and APAC. 

Oversee regulatory submissions, launch readiness, design changes, and medical device policy activities for medical device portfolio
Support broad health initiatives by coordinating cross-functional programs that advance Apple's medical device strategy across regions
Support China and APAC KOL engagement strategies — identifying, cultivating, and maintaining relationships with key opinion leaders, clinicians, and institutions across the region to support medical device regulatory and policy objectives
Plan and execute engagements and events across China and APAC in support of medical device policy priorities alongside various Apple teams
Establish a robust understanding of the overall critical path to coordinate medical device regulatory activities and resolve problems alongside cross-functional partners
Communicate program status and escalate risks to a variety of stakeholders

Solid understanding of medical device regulatory and policy processes for different device classes, with familiarity across China and APAC markets

Demonstrated experience planning and executing engagements, events, or partnership programs with external stakeholders in a medical device context
Proven track record of driving medical device regulatory submissions and launches with multi-disciplinary teams
Outstanding communication and organizational skills. Ability to optimally manage multiple projects simultaneously

Track record of developing and managing strategic partnerships with clinical, academic, or industry organizations in the medical device space
Proven track record of driving quality system updates and medical device regulator engagements
Experience coordinating regional advisory boards, clinical partnerships, or scientific engagement programs
Experience with implementation of tools and systems for process management
Requires travel

You will host recurring reviews with business partners, product owners, and technical teams, focusing on recent incidents and projects, while driving change to build additional fault tolerance within our tools and systems. Your exceptional analytical skills will support proactive identification of issues before being reported by our business partners or customers.

Deepen subject matter expertise through personal and professional development and in-the-moment support experiences
Participate in cross-functional project teams by representing ROPS and sharing your technical expertise to implement new solutions and enhance existing solutions
Build and maintain productive working relationships with internal customers and business partners
Apply data analytical skillset to identify emerging trends and to deliver operational improvements (reduced incident occurrence, decreased ticket duration, etc)
Create and distribute leadership and executive level summaries for high priority incidents

Apple-200685344.description:

Join Apple and help us leave the world better than we found it.

As part of Apple's Information Systems & Technology (IS&T) team, the SAP Security Administrator will deliver robust security solutions supporting SAP provisioning, authentication, authorization, and application-level security. In this role, you will apply enterprise resource planning (ERP) expertise and information security disciplines to protect critical business systems while solving complex challenges in an innovative, collaborative environment.

In this role, you will research, architect, and implement security solutions across Apple's dynamic and expanding SAP landscape. You will collaborate closely with Information Security, Audit, Compliance, and Engineering teams to strengthen access controls, mitigate risk, and enhance security processes. By leading technical initiatives and providing domain expertise, you will ensure our global SAP implementations remain resilient, compliant, and scalable.

Research and architect robust security solutions to support an expanding enterprise SAP landscape and complex project requirements.
Lead security design and governance across both on-premise systems and cloud platforms for current and future implementations.
Propose and implement technical and process improvements to continually strengthen application security, identity governance, and compliance.
Partner cross-functionally with Information Security, Internal Audit, Compliance, and Engineering teams to identify opportunities and advance security standards.
Document and communicate technical security architectures, roadmaps, and guidelines to build consensus across business and technical partners.
Oversee access governance, including managing Segregation of Duties (SOD) risks, applying mitigation controls, and monitoring elevated privileges and sensitive access.
Drive project execution by managing multiple security deliverables simultaneously while collaborating with distributed teams across multiple locations and time zones.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Security, or equivalent work experience.
5+ years of experience in security administration or technical security solutions across enterprise systems, networks, and applications.
Experience with SAP authorization concepts across enterprise platforms (such as ECC, BW, Portal, BPC, S/4HANA, or SAP Cloud solutions).
Experience integrating Identity Management (IdM) systems for provisioning and Directory Services for Single Sign-On (SSO) authentication.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience implementing and administering SAP GRC Access Control for centralized risk management, compliant provisioning, and role administration.
Experience analyzing Segregation of Duties (SOD) conflicts, defining mitigation controls, and monitoring critical access.
Experience utilizing continuous monitoring and configuration validation tools (such as SAP Solution Manager Configuration Validation, System Recommendations, or similar platforms).
Proven track record of architecting and leading complex security initiatives from concept to deployment within large-scale environments.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving abilities with a proactive, continuous-improvement mindset.
Experience successfully collaborating with multi-functional, globally distributed teams across different time zones.

We are looking for an SAP Test Lead to join our Business Process Re-engineering (BPR) group. In this role, you will support planning, creating, scheduling, coordinating, and executing tests for projects within the WW SOS Operations organization. You will partner with project managers and development teams to ensure high-quality products for our business and customers while continuously improving our testing practices. Description: You will manage end-to-end test activities, including test strategy, planning, execution, team coordination, and communication. By driving the successful release of system enhancements and new functionalities through effective user acceptance testing, you will play a critical role in our operations.

Manage end-to-end test activities, including test strategy, planning, execution, team coordination, and communication.
Drive the successful release of system enhancements and new functionalities through effective user acceptance testing.
Design and operationalize robust test data management strategies.
Develop test plans and facilitate the creation of test cases and scripts across multiple projects of varying sizes.
Facilitate end-to-end test scenario creation, bridging various functionalities through manual or automated processes.
Negotiate with cross-functional teams and business partners to remove barriers and drive results without compromising quality.
Create, maintain, and report on testing metrics, including SLAs and KPIs, while continuously improving testing best practices.
Determine the test automation approach and scope for projects, maintaining a comprehensive testing knowledge repository for the BPR team.

Apple-200688133.title: SDET - Wallet Payments & Commerce
Apple-200688133.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Every product we build or service we deliver is the result of people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives making each other’s ideas stronger. When we bring everybody in, we do the best work of our lives. Here, you will do more than join something — you will add something.

The Wallet, Payments & Commerce (WPC) Quality Engineering team is looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) with strong testing fundamentals and a passion for automation and software quality. In this role, you will collaborate with a talented, inclusive, and cross-functional engineering team dedicated to qualifying best-in-class Apple Pay and Wallet experiences. You will have the unique opportunity to design robust automation frameworks, tackle complex integration challenges, and shape products that delight and inspire millions of customers around the world every day.

As a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) on the Wallet, Payments & Commerce (WPC) Quality Engineering team, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the uncompromising quality, security, and reliability of Apple Pay and Wallet experiences. In this role, you will design, build, and scale automated testing solutions across server systems, end-to-end integration workflows, and user-facing features.

You will collaborate with a passionate team of engineers to establish and elevate testing methodologies, architect resilient automation frameworks, and integrate automated test suites seamlessly into our continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines. You will take ownership of technical challenges—from simulating complex payment flows to qualifying integrations with diverse regional ecosystems—ensuring our systems scale efficiently and deliver flawless user experiences.

To succeed in this role, you bring strong programming and architectural fundamentals, a deep curiosity about how systems fail, and a passion for automation craftsmanship. You will partner cross-functionally with local and global development teams, product managers, and engineering project managers (EPMs) to drive quality early in the lifecycle and ship products that surprise and delight millions of customers worldwide.  

Architect & Scale Test Automation: Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks, libraries, and internal tools for server-side services and end-to-end integration flows.
Drive Shift-Left Engineering: Partner closely with software developers and architects early in the design phase to align on testability, define comprehensive test strategies, and catch defects early in the development lifecycle.
Continuous Integration & Delivery (CI/CD): Integrate, monitor, and optimize automated test suites within modern CI/CD pipelines to enable rapid, high-confidence deployments.
Deep-Dive Triage & Root Cause Analysis: Investigate, diagnose, and drive fast resolution for complex automation failures, flaky tests, and distributed system anomalies across diverse test environments.
Innovate with Modern Tooling & AI: Explore and adopt emerging technologies—including leveraging AI tools and generative workflows—to streamline test authoring, failure triage, and daily QA efficiency.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Mentorship: Partner with product managers, EPMs, and global engineering teams to identify testing requirements, establish release criteria, and execute against milestones, while conducting code reviews and mentoring peers to foster engineering excellence.
Apple-200688133.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
BS/MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong programming fundamentals with proficiency in an object-oriented language such as Java, Kotlin, or Python, with an emphasis on clean code and maintainable design.
Proven experience building and maintaining automated testing frameworks and test suites at scale across backend services or end-to-end integration flows.
Deep understanding of software QA methodologies, including test strategy design, API/microservices validation (contract, integration, and component testing), and root cause analysis.
Hands-on experience integrating test automation into modern CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous, automated test execution.
Strong communication skills in both English and Mandarin, with the ability to articulate technical issues clearly and collaborate effectively with global cross-functional teams.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Years of Domain Experience: 3+ years of dedicated experience in software development in test (SDET), backend automation engineering, or distributed systems testing.
Advanced Testing & Mocking Paradigms: Hands-on experience with service virtualization and simulation tools and contract testing frameworks.
Distributed Systems & Infrastructure: Solid understanding of operating systems, networking fundamentals (HTTP/HTTPS, REST, gRPC), and containerized cloud environments (e.g., Kubernetes, AWS), along with modern deployment strategies such as canary releases.
Domain Context: Familiarity with high-availability distributed systems, financial technology, or digital payment ecosystems.
AI-Assisted Engineering: Hands-on experience leveraging modern developer tools, including AI-assisted workflows and LLM-driven tooling, to optimize test authoring, failure triage, and QA productivity.
Leadership & Navigation of Ambiguity: Demonstrated track record of leading technical initiatives, mentoring peers, and driving quality standards forward in fast-evolving, ambiguous environments.
Collaborative Problem-Solving & Craftsmanship: Strong collaborative mindset—able to respectfully debate technical trade-offs to reach the best outcome for the product—with deep dedication to customer privacy, security, and exceptional user experience.

Apple-200681650.title: Senior Brand Strategist
Apple-200681650.description:
Marketing Communications (Marcom) is the creatively led global team that oversees Apple’s consumer-facing marketing. We ensure the flawless development and execution of world-class communications across all media and platforms. Every day, hundreds of millions of Apple customers around the world interact with our products. We drive the strategy and creative work that deliver simple, engaging, and inspiring marketing experiences to both new and existing customers.

The Senior Brand Strategist is pivotal to identifying high-impact strategic opportunities and shaping how Apple articulates brand and product narratives across Greater China. This role bridges global brand ambition with local market realities, uncovering unaddressed consumer needs and setting the strategic foundation for truly integrated campaigns.

As Senior Brand Strategist in Greater China, you will act as the strategic anchor underpinning Apple’s product launches, locally originated initiatives, and brand narratives. In this role, you will proactively identify whitespace opportunities in the market, decode complex cultural dynamics, and partner cross-functionally to inspire category-defining creative work across touchpoints.

Continuously interrogate market dynamics, competitor shifts, and behavioral trends to identify strategic whitespace and proactively frame business and brand opportunities. 
Lead end-to-end strategic planning for local campaigns—from framing business objectives to authoring creative briefs and establishing measurement metrics.
Architect holistic, multi-touchpoint campaign strategies beyond traditional advertising to seamlessly integrate digital, social platforms, physical/online retail, interactive experiences.
Distill deep cultural currents and consumer truths into briefs that inspire category-defining work.
Deliver timely market and cultural intelligence to fuel strategic alignment between Greater China Marketing and Worldwide teams.
Partner across cross-functional teams to pioneer creative and communications breakthroughs.
Apple-200681650.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
8+ years of strategic planning experience within leading creative agencies, brand consultancies, or client-side global brand marketing teams.
Experience across the full strategic spectrum, spanning business and brand strategy, consumer research, insight synthesis, and integrated communications planning.
Proven track record of independently authoring inspiring creative briefs and shaping high-impact strategic platforms for Greater China initiatives.
Mastery in written, visual, and verbal storytelling, with the presence to engage and influence multidisciplinary teams.
Full professional fluency in written and spoken Mandarin and English.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Expertise in the consumer electronics and tech landscape.
Native fluency in China’s social and digital ecosystem (Douyin, rednote, Bilibili).
Ability to synthesize complex, ambiguous inputs into sharp, actionable strategic points of view.
Strong cultural antennae, with an innate curiosity for pop culture, design, and innovation.
Proven ability to collaborate and build alignment across diverse, multidisciplinary teams.
Advanced Keynote storytelling craft and active fluency with AI productivity workflows.

Apple-200693007.title: Senior Finance Operations Manager, Services
Apple-200693007.description:
Are you passionate about using your financial knowledge to navigate complex cross functional challenges? Just as our customers find value in Apple products, the Finance group finds value for both Apple and its shareholders. As part of this group, you will support Apple’s growth, applying the same level of innovation toward financial matters as we do toward our products and services. You will be defining, leading and delivering programs to optimize the financial lifecycle of our rapidly expanding digital Services Businesses.

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Finance Program Manager with prior experience in driving large cross functional global initiatives, such as ERP implementations, Finance Transformations and new product introductions.

The ideal candidate will possess a combination of a strong blend of financial acumen, passion for innovation and ability to confidently collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Finance stakeholders with minimal oversight.

You will also have a deep understanding of digital services business models, such as Subscriptions and Payments and have the ability to assess a bigger picture to understand & communicate impact to Finance and our partners

Lead finance tracks such as Accounting Kit and CIP integrations, execute configurations and exception handling. 
Support Finance to review to assess the impact of new initiatives on the functional and technical landscape involving SAP implementations. 
Provide expert feedback and mentorship on solution designs, particularly for regulatory and compliance-related projects.
Establish, publish, and professionally enforce architectural guidelines for the entire SAP suite of applications and developed solutions.
Communicate and foster feedback from multiple parties, brokering decisions in situations where multiple opinions or options exist.
Optimize Services Finance UAT timelines and milestones
Ensure proposed solutions are SOX compliant.

10+ years of experience in the SAP domain with a significant focus on solution or enterprise architecture.
Proven experience in a solution or enterprise architecture role within a large-scale, complex SAP environment.
Broad functional and technical knowledge across SAP products, platforms, and technologies.
Experience defining and executing system strategies for large-scale enterprise systems.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

MBA, Engineering background
Experience with Services, subscription, or platform business models (e.g., recurring revenue, marketplace, or digital services).
Experience in implementing new systems for digital services
Prior Big 4 or public accounting experience.

This role is a hands-on product leadership role responsible for defining and delivering AI-powered solutions across live streaming moderation, VOC analytics and cross platform conversational AI products. This role will own the product lifecycle management and drive execution for AI systems that protect brand integrity in social commerce environments while transforming customer feedback into actionable business intelligence. Working under the assumption that the product can be scalable across platforms and countries, ensuring alignment between local market needs and global scalability.

You will lead the end-to-end product development of AI moderation tools for live streaming commerce and VOC intelligence platforms that analyze customer sentiment, feedback, and behavioral signals across digital touchpoints. The role demands a strong technical understanding of AI capabilities, deep familiarity with APAC social commerce ecosystems, and the ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clearly defined product requirements. You will work closely with engineering teams, digital experience, customer care team to ship products that balance automation with human oversight.

Key Responsibilities:
Own and prioritize the product backlog for live streaming AI moderation, VOC AI products and potential other AI products across multiple APAC markets.
Define product requirements and acceptance criteria for AI models, moderation workflows, and customer analytics dashboards.
Collaborate with regional teams (CN, RPAC, etc) to gather market-specific requirements and validate product-market fit.
Act as the bridge between technical teams and business stakeholders, translating AI capabilities into tangible business value.

Product strategy and roadmap: define and communicate the product vision, strategy and roadmap for AI moderation and VOC products; align with APAC leadership and global teams on prioritization and resource allocation.
Backlog management and execution: own and maintain prioritized backlogs; write detailed use stories, acceptance criteria, and technical requirements; lead sprint planning, grooming and review ceremonies with engineering teams.
Live streaming AI moderation: design and iterate on real-time content moderation systems for live commerce, including automated risk detection, policy enforcement workflows, and human-in-the-loop escalation paths.
Voice of Customer Product Development: build AI-driven analytics products that aggregate, classify and extract insights from customer feedback across chat, reviews, and social channels; deliver actionable dashboards and alerts to business stakeholders.
Cross-platform AI expansion: identify opportunities to extend AI moderation and VOC capabilities to additional channels and markets; define integration requirements and platform APIs. Ability to catch the market trends and best practices to recommend the ideal technical solutions.
Stakeholder management: partner with legal, privacy legal, digital experience, customer care teams to ensure moderation places and VOC insights align with brand standards and regulatory requirements.

Proven track record of working with engineering teams to ship AI-powered products in contact center, e-commerce systems and technologies.
Demonstrated ability to influence at all levels of an organization, whether with a peer or senior/exec level leadership.
Majored in Computer Science, Engineering, Data science, Business or related field. 
Professional proficiency in both English and Mandarin.

Experience in building products for live streaming or short-video platforms (e.g., TikTok, Douyin, Taobao)

Strong understanding of NLP, sentiment analysis, and classification models. Familiarity with multi-model AI systems (text, image, etc.) and real-time streaming infrastructure.
Experience working in a platform or shared services model, serving multiple regional teams with configurable solutions.

It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. At Apple, inclusion is a shared responsibility, and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.

Here on the Apple Store Online team, we are responsible for Apple’s largest store. Our main goal is to deliver a magical, personal digital experience where customers can shop, buy and learn everything Apple, wherever they are. Each customer should feel like they are our only customer and our job is to set the bar for the experience they receive. To run such an extraordinary store, it takes extraordinary people, and we are looking for someone to help us do extraordinary things.

Our team within Apple Store Online is responsible for delivering scalable, efficient, and customer centric technical solutions to serve our Retail Customers and Call Center Specialists globally. We continuously pursue excellence by evaluating and rethinking the customer journey through the online shopping experience, including Digital Programs, Chat/Voice systems, Payments, Fulfillment, Delivery, and Customer Care.  This role looks beyond the immediate to thoughtfully innovate on the details leveraging the latest cutting edge technology to elevate the shopping experience globally.

In this individual contributor role, you will own a product portfolio and partner cross functionally to strategize and deliver projects and initiatives that drive a world class customer experience. You will build new applications or features used by customers and Retail Contact Center (RCC) Specialists.You will develop a deep understanding of the customer online journey and RCC community experience to design and analyze solutions and processes, including Generative AI and LLM capabilities. You will turn these concepts into reality by collaborating across project management, engineering, AIML, design, and operational teams.

Ideating and implementing generative solutions within the contact center infrastructure supporting end-to-end specialist and Customer journey, including, but not limited to enhancing how we route engagements, enable Omnichannel/multimodal experiences,  personalize the experience for Specialist and Customers, and introduce solutions that speed ramp for specialists.
Defining and communicating multi year strategies and roadmaps, requirements, and deployment plans to achieve business objectives.
Creating buy-in for product vision and generative AI solutions
Lead and simplify lasting technical and analytical solutions.
Understanding and explaining complex business processes, systems, and tools with a keen focus on upstream/downstream impact
Monitoring data and trends to identify product gaps and issues and solve them
Leading user roundtables and gathering customer/user insights to inform business and technical decisions
Apple-200678103.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
7+ years of professional experience in Product Management for e-commerce or a consumer digital product development 
Record of leading complex technical projects with direct ownership of a product portfolio
Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively and influence at all levels of an organization
Experience in leveraging data and insights to deliver customer-facing digital products and capabilities globally
BA/BS degree or 11+ years professional experience in a directly relatable role

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience with E-commerce environment, specially in order and support processes, customer contact methodologies, contact center applications and processes
Advanced knowledge of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Project and Product management methodologies (PMP, SCRUM/Agile, Waterfall)
Understanding of and application of AI within a contact center environment
Capable of leading technical discussions involving software infrastructure/architecture, APIs, programming languages, and other technical subject matter
Demonstrated experience being an interface between business and technical teams.
Experience in one or more of the following: UI/UX design, macOS experience, and experience with User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
BA/BS in Computer Science or a technical degree

Apple-200681694.description:

We’re a diverse collective of thinkers and doers, continuously reimagining our products and practices to help people do what they love in new ways. That innovation is inspired by a shared commitment to great work and to each other. Learning from our people here means we're learning from the best! The RDM team create and care for Apple Stores that look, feel, and function as beautifully as our products. We do this by obsessing over the employee and customer experience, and driving a global strategy that sets the bar.

The Retail Technology China team is responsible for the end-to-end digital app and hardware experience in Apple Retail China stores, including all aspects of the customer and employee experience.

As a Senior Product Manager in the Retail Technology team, you will be a part of a diverse and supportive team that ensures our technology fulfills Apple’s vision of enabling employees to deliver the best retail experience in the world to our customers across China. This work sits across the full Retail Technology portfolio including but not limited to demo capabilities and/or apps, product discovery and pricing experiences, customer self-led end to end journeys including checkout, purchase and fulfillment experiences, ways to buy and services offering experiences, post-purchase experiences including Genius Bar and repair services, and back of house experiences (e.g., inventory management, reporting, leadership operations). The role is highly cross functional and requires deep collaboration across Apple and the China market.  Responsibilities: (include up to 4 bullets)
Develop the product strategy and delivery approach that represents the interests of business and technology through the design, development, and deployment of technology and systems, ensuring proper data treatment in China.
Ensure coordination of funding, release schedules, communicate status, issue resolution, resource alignment, and quality standards are met.
Collaborate with business partners and engineering teams to identify, mobilize, and execute solutions leading to design reviews, feature prioritization, and negotiating features to meet release schedules.
Create artifacts throughout the product delivery cycle from ideation to delivery go live and post production health.
Be in the details, understand the business problem or opportunity to solve, understand the technology stack and its integrations, services, APIs, and future roadmaps to ensure scalable and future proof experiences
Ensure all project documentation is accurate and prepared appropriately for the audience, varying from status reports, risk and mitigation plans, decision logs, bug tracking, meeting notes and action items, executive presentations, and others as directed by leadership.

Proven ability to manage and deliver multiple complex, large-scale, global projects and programs across a wide portfolio of software and hardware concurrently
Experience using AI throughout the software and/or hardware development lifecycle and project/program management systems
Experience with Apple hardware and operating systems
Fluent in Mandarin and English

Experience delivering software and/or hardware experiences in China for a retail, e-commerce, or consumer organization
Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate eﬀectively across all levels of an organization
Proven ability to bring clarity to ambiguity and lead without direct authority

Apple-200678047.title: Senior Robotics Expert
Apple-200678047.description:
The people here at Apple don’t just build products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that encourages the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple and help us leave the world better than we found it. 

We are looking for a versatile and experienced Sr. Robotics Expert with end-to-end system expertise to accelerate the exploration of new concepts, and to bring innovative ideas to life through efficient hands-on hardware and experience-focused prototyping. Your work will directly influence future explorations by demonstrating the viability and potential of new technologies.

You will take on a Sr. technical role in exploring, analyzing, defining, building hardware prototypes and testing. You will play a key role in developing critical partnerships with key component and module vendors as well as research institutes to accelerate development cycles. You will closely collaborate with global teams and partners.

Explore and develop new concepts by building hardware prototypes and developing new AI experience demos
Track rapid technology advancements and market trends to guide explorations 
Evaluate key components and technologies such as actuators, sensors and control modules, and guide/verify technology improvements
Develop critical partnerships with key vendors and research institutes to enable highly efficient development
Collaborate closely with multi-disciplinary experts globally to define and achieve project goals
Apple-200678047.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
PhD/MS/BS in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics or equivalent with solid, practical problem-solving experience
5+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, and testing robotic systems that encompass both hardware and software components
Deep expertise in one or more areas that are critical for robotic system development such as electrical system design, motion control, mechatronics design, firmware and software development
Strong written and verbal English communication skills for global teamwork

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Proven experience in system integration, bringing together complex hardware (sensors, actuators) and software (firmware, control, perception) into a functional system
Deep expertise in one or more of the following: end-to-end robotics integration, motor drive and control, camera/sensor/display integration, and related technologies 
Expertise in Embodied AI (Physical AI) model development and application 
Deep connection with related technology vendors and research institutes
Experience delivering high-volume products from concept to mass production

It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation running through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

Apple’s Services—including the App Store, iCloud, Apple Music, Apple TV, and many others—are among the most dynamic and widely used in the world. As the regulatory landscape continues to evolve, our organization requires proactive, technically rigorous leadership on the ground in China to ensure our platforms navigate emerging obligations while preserving product integrity and user trust.

We are seeking a senior leader based in China to represent Apple’s Services engineering organization on the regulatory and compliance issues that shape how our services operate in China. You will lead an in-country team responsible for strategy, interpretation, advocacy, and execution across China regulatory, compliance, and partner engineering work. You will serve as the senior Services regulatory and compliance leader in China and engage directly with regulators, assessment bodies, and auditors. You will work in close partnership with our colleagues in Legal and Government Affairs, who lead on legal interpretation and government relations, and with Apple’s China leadership, ensuring that regulatory and compliance strategy reflects Apple’s priorities and presence in the country.

You will bring the engineering and business perspective that turns those efforts into workable outcomes, and you will bridge communication with our global teams

Apple operates services in China at a scope and scale unlike any other multinational company. The challenges we face have no playbook. Our work is exceptionally complex, ambiguous, and vital to Apple’s operations. This role is focused on how expanding data, cybersecurity, internet, and AI regulations in China affect Apple’s services. It drives the practical application of those regulations into systems architecture, data governance, data export, and content operations.

This role covers the full arc of that work: shaping Apple’s strategy, interpreting what regulations mean for our systems, advocating for workable approaches with regulators and assessors, and driving execution with engineering and partners. You represent Apple’s global engineering organization, and you solve problems from the business and engineering perspective with our essential partners in Legal and Government Affairs.

In response to these regulatory and compliance obligations, Apple maintains strategic and operating partnerships for several of our services in China. This role manages in-country engagement for regulatory and compliance, collaborating closely with local operating and technology partners, local Apple teams, and US engineering leadership. 

The goal is for our services to operate reliably and securely while remaining compliant with evolving rules.

Defining & Driving In-Country Regulatory Programs: You partner closely with Apple’s Legal, Government Affairs, policy, and technical experts to understand local regulations, policies, and emerging risks. You set priorities for the work and develop plans for how requirements map to Apple’s services, considering Apple’s products, policies, and services architecture. You develop concrete technical options, trade-offs, and actionable recommendations for global engineering and business leadership, and you drive them to decisions.

Interpretation & Resolution of Hard Problems: You lead the issues with no precedent, conflicting requirements, or material business impact. You work with our partner teams to turn ambiguous requirements into defensible, implementable positions that we can operate under, and that engineering can build against.

Direct Technical & Regulatory Engagement: You serve as the senior local voice of Services engineering in direct dialogue with regulatory authorities, government ministries, designated assessment institutions, and external auditors. You advocate for Apple’s engineering and product approach in high-stakes regulatory discussions, formal assessments, and technical reviews, including Multi-Level Protection Scheme (MLPS) audits and Cross-border Data Transfer Security Assessments.

Strategic Partner & Relationship Management: You serve as an in-country leader managing regulatory and compliance relationships with critical operating partners in China. You navigate the operational, technical, and cultural dynamics between organizations. You build trusted partnerships to resolve complex compliance issues while protecting Apple’s engineering and product principles.

Technical Depth & Solution Design: You bring the technical depth to evaluate how regulations apply to our systems, including service architectures, backend data flows, cloud infrastructure, identity, and AI/ML systems. Rather than relaying regulatory mandates back to the US, you and your team partner closely with global engineering to inform sound, scalable, and compliant technical solutions.

People Leadership & Team Building: You lead an in-country team responsible for driving key on-the-ground China regulatory and compliance work across Services. You foster deep ownership, develop senior talent and future leaders, and empower your team to support Apple’s global teams.

Executive Communication & Cross-Cultural Influence: You communicate and influence effectively with leadership across Apple in both the US and China, including Apple’s China leadership team, and keep them informed on regulatory developments and decisions that affect the business in country. You bridge geographic and cultural distances, align competing priorities across distributed teams, and drive consensus on high-stakes technical and policy decisions.

Scaling Through Process & Frameworks: You scale your team’s impact by designing practical operating processes, regulatory intake and review mechanisms, audit-readiness processes, and governance frameworks. These bring structure and repeatable execution to complex mandates and integrate with Apple’s global teams.
Apple-200685584.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
 12+ years of professional experience, including 8+ years owning regulatory or compliance strategy for technology products or services. This means setting direction, interpreting requirements, and making or driving consequential decisions, not only executing programs or audits.
A demonstrated record of resolving novel, high-stakes regulatory or compliance problems with material business impact, including advocating for difficult positions and presenting options and recommendations to senior executives.
Direct experience representing technology or engineering organizations in regulatory engagements, government assessments, or technical audits with Chinese regulatory authorities or designated assessment bodies. This includes hands-on familiarity with frameworks such as MLPS and Cross-border Data Transfer Security Assessments.
8+ years of people management, including leading senior specialists or managers and building teams.
Technical fluency to engage engineers credibly on service architectures, backend data flows, cloud infrastructure, identity, data residency, and AI/ML systems, and to evaluate technical options against regulatory requirements.
Working knowledge of China’s data, cybersecurity, and AI regulatory landscape and of how these obligations interact.
Proven track record managing and negotiating complex technical, operational, or business relationships with external strategic partners, platform operators, or service providers.
Complete bilingual professional fluency in Mandarin Chinese and English (written and spoken), with proven mastery leading technical reviews, negotiating complex issues, and presenting to executive and government audiences in both languages.
Demonstrated excellence in communicating with and influencing senior leadership across global engineering, legal, business, product, and operations organizations across time zones.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience building and scaling an in-region regulatory, compliance, or technical compliance team within a global technology company.
Experience with local cloud infrastructure, third-party data center operations, and joint operating models in China.
Direct experience handling regulatory filings and compliance reviews for internet information services, algorithms, or content delivery systems in China.
Deep domain experience with consumer internet platforms, cloud infrastructure, or identity and account architectures operating at massive global scale.
Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree is a plus.
