Apple-200677498.title: Site Reliability Engineer / Devops — Retail Engineering
Apple-200677498.description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.

 Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here. Retail and Marcom Engineering, an IS&T team, builds and operates the systems and experiences that connect Apple's products with its customers. The team owns the technology behind both Apple's online and physical stores and drives the interactive marketing experiences and tools that keep creative operations moving. 
Together, those functions deliver the technology behind every product story Apple tells and every purchase a customer makes.

You will drive the reliability, deployment, and scalability of compute platforms across on-premises and hybrid cloud environments. Collaborating closely with cross-functional technical and business partners, you will build Infrastructure as Code, optimize container orchestration, and streamline CI/CD delivery pipelines. You will champion automation and operational excellence, ensuring high availability, robust security standards, and proactive observability across large-scale distributed systems.

Deploy, support and monitor compute platforms and application stacks.
Ability to understand complex systems and a desire to constantly make things better
Explore and evaluate new technologies and solutions.
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively across multiple business and technical teams
Develop and fix the application on failures.
We promote innovation and use of new technology to further improve our creative output. We’re looking for a talented and passionate person to join this amazing team, if you feel this is you, we’d love to hear from you.
Apple-200677498.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent field with 7+ years of experience, or Master’s degree with 5+ years of experience.
7+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering with a strong focus on building, scaling, and operating large-scale distributed platform services, and Java applications.
Strong technical grasp of Open Source technologies designed for large-scale data processing.
Proven expertise in designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting complex distributed systems.
Proficiency in at least one modern programming or scripting language (Python, Java, Go, Bash, Ansible, or similar).
Practical experience designing and deploying end-to-end observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, ELK, etc.).
Demonstrated troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across production software and infrastructure environments.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
In-depth understanding of SRE principles, including error budgeting, SLO/SLI/SLA definition, and advanced observability practices (Prometheus, Splunk, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).
Advanced programming skills in Java, Python, or Go, with hands-on experience across relational, NoSQL, or OLAP databases and event-driven streaming architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
Track record of managing production on-call rotations, critical incident triage, root cause analysis (RCA), and post-incident reviews (PIR).
Solid knowledge of enterprise security standards, cryptography, authentication protocols (OAuth, SAML, SSO), and compliance governance.

The team owns the technology behind both Apple’s online and physical stores and drives the interactive marketing experiences and tools that keep creative operations moving. Together, those functions deliver the technology behind every product story Apple tells and every purchase a customer makes.

Imagine what you could do here! The people here at Apple don’t just create products -  they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. At Apple, inclusion is a shared responsibility, and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.

Here on the Retail Engineering Operations & Support team (REOS), we provide world-class support to Apple stores worldwide, both online and physical stores. Our main goal is to facilitate a magical, personalized shopping experience where customers can buy, and learn everything Apple, wherever they are. To achieve this, we’re looking for someone with extraordinary talent and passion to help us do extraordinary things!

We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Support Engineer to work with a global team, guide and mentor them, and collaborate with leads and managers to drive technical and process improvements.    

This position primarily involves working in a global team of 24/7 to support our eCommerce platform - Apple Online Store and its users. You’ll actively work on, own, and drive triage of critical system issues. Additionally, you’ll coordinate with key stakeholders and other support teams in high-pressure situations to ensure quick service restoration. You will take responsibility of complex tasks and be able to exercise independent discretion to apply deep technical principles to complex projects.

You will partner with engineering and business teams to drive issue resolution and RCA. You will solve complex problems, possess a high degree of organization, and communicate effectively across a variety of technical disciplines. You will also bring in a growth mindset to identify opportunities for automation, optimization, support efficiency and efficacy improvements.

Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to see the big picture while working in the details in a fast-paced, multifaceted, 24x365 environment.
Strong problem-solving skills to handle high-pressure outage situations and conduct root-cause analysis.
Excellent communication skills to manage stakeholder expectations and translate technical problems for non-technical users.
8+ years of experience in IT operations, support, SRE and/or security.
Organized, detail-oriented, with ability to multi-task & prioritize work efficiently.
Coding knowledge of Java, Scala or other object-oriented languages.
Experience with one or more - Splunk, monitoring tools, APM & observability tools.
Good working knowledge of RDBMS, PL/SQL.
Working experience on cloud infra, like AWS.
Bachelor's degree or higher in CS or in a STEM field.
Fluency in both Mandarin Chinese and English is required. 

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience with an eCommerce System as a developer, SRE/support engineer.
Experience with a NoSQL platform, preferably Solr or Cassandra.
Automation experience using AI/ML.  
Exposure to Incident and Problem Management processes is a plus.

Apple-200686503.title: Software Application Support Engineer, Retail Engineering Operations & Support
Apple-200686503.description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.

Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.

Retail and Marcom Engineering, an IS&T team, builds and operates the systems and experiences that connect Apple’s products with its customers. The team owns the technology behind both Apple’s online and physical stores and drives the interactive marketing experiences and tools that keep creative operations moving. Together, those functions deliver the technology behind every product story Apple tells and every purchase a customer makes.

Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, excellent ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there’s no telling what you could accomplish.

We at Apple don’t just build products, we craft the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries! Apple is where individual creativities come together to create extraordinary products and services. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver, is the result of us making each other's ideas stronger!

Here on the Retail Engineering Operations & Support team (REOS), we provide world-class support to Apple stores worldwide, both online and physical stores. Our main goal is to facilitate a magical, personalized shopping experience where customers can buy, and learn everything Apple, wherever they are. To achieve this, we’re looking for someone with extraordinary talent and passion to help us do extraordinary things!
We are seeking a Software Application Support Engineer, who will collaborate closely with engineers from various technical backgrounds and to resolve issues across Apple’s retail applications. As a hands-on, proactive problem solver, you will challenge the status quo, continuously learn, and strive for excellence in every aspect of your work. Critical thinking, analysis, documenting, and communicating within the team and cross-functionally is critical to the success of the role. 

Your role will include: 
Partnering with engineering teams to prioritize and fix production defects.
Managing and troubleshooting global incidents related to Apple Online Store for our user base globally. 
Contributing to the development of functional requirements, technical specifications, and support documentation for automation and process improvements.
Conducting root cause analysis, logging defects, and collaborating with engineering, leadership and partner teams to prioritize fixes.
Assisting with the global support strategy for new product releases and feature launches.
Collaborating on cross-functional process enhancements to improve efficiency and service quality.
Triage and prioritize incidents based on the impact, devise and implement mitigation steps to unblock the business.   
Conduct RCA, log defects and partner with engineering team for prioritization.
Automation, maintain support documentation and debug complex production issues.
Work non-standard hours to support your teams with ongoing incident mitigation, which may occur at any time/day of the week. 
Share on-call rotation with other team members to support apps and services in scope. 
Take knowledge transition from engineering teams for changes being rolled out in production. Assess the need for production monitoring and alert setup.
Apple-200686503.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor's degree or higher in CS or in a STEM field
1+ years of software engineering or application support experience
Skills and experience in monitoring, alerting, fault analysis, and automation and ITIL practices and standards
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
Coding knowledge in Java, Python, Scala and frameworks related to Java
Good knowledge of RDBMS, PL/SQL
Fluency in both Mandarin Chinese and English 

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Broad understanding and first-hand experience with LLM-based tools and agentic workflows
Working experience on cloud infra, like AWS, is a plus
Experience with Splunk, monitoring tools, APM & observability
Support experience with eCommerce platform is a plus
Good knowledge of Unix Shell Scripting

Apple-200686499.title: Software Quality Engineer, Retail & Marcom Engineering
Apple-200686499.description:
The people here at Apple don’t just build products — we craft the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that supports the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

Are you passionate about solving complex business challenges with process engineering and technology? Do you thrive in environments that require multi-functional thinking, collaboration, and innovation? If so, this may be the job for you. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.

Retail and Marcom Engineering, an IS&T team, builds and operates the systems and experiences that connect Apple's products with its customers. The team owns the technology behind both Apple's online and physical stores and drives the interactive marketing experiences and tools that keep creative operations moving. Together, those functions deliver the technology behind every product story Apple tells and every purchase a customer makes.

The Retail Engineering Point of Sale (POS) team is responsible for the technology and IT systems used to enable Apple Retail Stores service to millions of customers and are an industry leader in Retail. As part of this team, you'll contribute to the infrastructure that keeps Apple’s award-winning retail experience running seamlessly.

As a Quality Engineer you'll need to take an active role in shaping the quality of our software. This will demand deep integration with our development engineers, creating test plans, bug reporting and triaging, identifying automation opportunities, and supporting design reviews. You'll help us identify holes in coverage, actively sync with multi-functional teams to reduce duplication, foster better testing, and preserve product stability. We are building a passionate and diverse team that will span a broad range of applications, tools, and frameworks. We need your help to reach Apple's high standards of quality.

Design and execute comprehensive test plans for iOS features, covering functional, regression, and integration testing scenarios
Develop and maintain automated test scripts to improve test coverage and efficiency
Identify, document, and track software defects through the entire bug lifecycle, working closely with engineering teams to ensure timely resolution
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers during feature development to ensure quality requirements are defined and testable
Validate software builds, device configurations, and use cases to ensure compatibility and performance
Contribute to continuous improvement of quality processes, testing tools, and automation frameworks
Report on testing progress, quality metrics, and release readiness to stakeholders, providing clear insights into product quality

BA/BS degree or equivalent experience
3+ years of relevant testing experience
Proficiency in Java or similar language
Proficiency in SQL

Experience testing iOS applications
Hands-on experience using generative AI/LLMs for test generation, code review, and
documentation
Excellent communication skills with a sense of ownership and ability to advocate for quality
across teams
Self-motivated with sharp attention to detail and a mindset for finding edge cases
Track record of reducing repetitive manual processes through automation and tooling
improvements in Python Java or similar language.
Strong understanding of functional, regression, integration, and performance testing
methodologies
Ability to read and assess code quality and risk across Java or similar languages
Demonstrated ability to analyze complex problems, prioritize issues by customer impact, and
collaborate cross-functionally to troubleshoot and resolve production issues.

Apple-200684052.title: Sr. Project Manager - Digital Commerce (ASO)
Apple-200684052.description:
Imagine what you could do here! The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. At Apple, inclusion is a shared responsibility, and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.  

Here on the Apple Store Online team, we are responsible for Apple’s largest store. Our main goal is to deliver a magical, personal digital experience where customers can shop, buy and learn everything Apple, wherever they are. Each customer should feel like they are our only customer and our job is to set the bar for the experience they receive. To run such an extraordinary store, it takes extraordinary people, and we are looking for someone to help us do extraordinary things.

Our Business Process Re-engineering (BPR) team within ASO is responsible for partnering cross functionally to deliver scalable, efficient, and customer centric processes and technology solutions to our Retail Customers and global network of Call Center Specialists. We are chartered with rethinking the shopping experience and the assisted sales touch-points we have throughout the customer journey, spanning Voice/Chat systems, Payments, Customer Care, Delivery, Fulfillment and many other Digital Programs.  

We’re looking for an exceptional Project Manager that brings deep technical proficiency alongside the skills more commonly associated with a PM, and that has a consistent record of leading diverse and complex projects from conception through implementation in either an e-Commerce or Contact Center landscape. In this role, you will traverse an array of project/program management skills (ex. business analytics, process mapping and optimization, business and technical requirement creation, influencing solution architecture, evaluating solutions through testing, leading others through change) to deliver new features and capabilities for ASO. 
- Lead end to end implementation of multiple mid-to-large scale regional and/or global eCommerce initiatives with overlapping timelines, on behalf of the Retail Online organization and partner teams. 
- Strive for operational excellence by incorporating Apple’s standard methodologies for Project Management, to ensure consistent delivery of quality business solutions. 
- Quickly become and serve as a resource and technical SME for Retail Online in the area where your project work takes you. 
- Contribute to an inclusive environment through respecting each others’ differences and having the curiosity to learn.

Lead all phases of projects including: project scope definition, resource forecasting and allocation, as-is and to-be process mapping, business requirement documentation, technical requirement creation, project timeline creation, project documentation, project communications (status, risks, scope changes, etc.), change management, user/integration/production testing, project cutover/go-live’s, retrospectives, and closeout.
Be the voice of their body of work. Communicate effectively and transparently across all levels of leadership within the organization, and drive discussions proactively when additional attention and focus is required.
Build strong relationships with partner teams both inside and outside of the organization, and use these strengths to positively influence the direction of their portfolio.
Understand complex system landscapes and offer technical suggestions to engineering teams and influence and shape system architecture and integration strategies and platform design
Collaborate with business and technology teams ensuring project objectives are being met, scope is continuously understood by all relevant parties, and that the technical solutions being implemented are as simple as possible yet lasting in tenure.
Drive project centric discussions and deep-dives with team members from diverse business and technical backgrounds and roles, and use these discussions to focus efforts on the objectives of their defined body of work.
Apple-200684052.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
BA/BS degree with 7+ years of professional experience working within a product, project, or program management role.
Broad experience working with Contact Center and/or e-Commerce systems and technologies (ex. payments/financing applications, order maintenance tools, workforce management applications, telephony/chat systems and infrastructure).
Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively and influence at all levels of an organization.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience working in a hands-on role, with total ownership for driving initiatives in their portfolio. Demonstrated experience should include being an interface role between business and technical teams.
Is a technical and analytical problem solver, stitches between their work and the broader strategy, and demonstrates adaptability in their approach to solving problems. Thinks with a focus on implementing simple but lasting solutions.
Demonstrated ability to understand and explain complex business processes, systems, and tools with a keen focus on upstream/downstream impact
Has worked within a global organization, where work may include a mix of regional or global scope and has familiarity and has used both Waterfall and Agile project management methodologies in their prior work experience.
Experience with SAP (S4 HANA), awareness of AI application within a contact center environment, knowledge of Genesys routing solutions, order to cash processes, etc. are differentiating and desirable skillsets.
PMP or Certified Scrum Master.

Apple-200654006.title: Strategic Partnerships Manager, APAC - Apple Vision Pro
Apple-200654006.description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something.
Apple Vision Pro is a revolutionary spatial computer that seamlessly blends digital content with your physical space. It will allow us to do the things we love in ways never before possible — all while staying connected to the people around us.

Apple's Vision Products Group (VPG) is looking for a savvy individual to drive partnership initiatives in the APAC region (with a strong focus on China) to develop the spatial computing ecosystem and deliver new and cutting edge experiences for Apple Vision Pro. You’ll play a major role in identifying the appropriate use cases, applications and partners leveraging the full potential of spatial computing in both the enterprise and entertainment sectors. Specifically you’ll be in charge of driving adoption of the Apple Immersive Video format across studios, broadcasters, video platforms and video production companies. You’ll also support the adoption of spatial computing across professional industries such as healthcare, automotive, and aviation with a diverse pool of partners, applications and clients. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams to support partners in adopting new technologies, tools, concepts and ways of working. Your success will be measured by your capacity to drive project from ideation to delivery to real customers and by enabling powerful adoption of spatial computing and Apple Vision Pro in APAC across industry leaders and innovators. 
If you are a dynamic and strategic thinker with strong technical proficiency and a passion for forging meaningful partnerships, we invite you to join our team.

Translate WW strategy into a localized and actionable plan for China and other APAC markets.
Identify, prioritise, and onboard strategic partners, taking into account market specifics and dynamics.
Manage relationships with strategic enterprise partners towards adoption of spatial computing in the workplace.
Drive adoption of the Apple Immersive Video format across China and APAC video entertainment industry.
Coordinate cross-functional effort necessary for the delivery of complex and innovative technical projects. 
Work very closely and in partnership with various internal functional partners and teams such as Developer Relations, Services, Enterprise and Sales.
Apple-200654006.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
BS in Computer Science / Engineering or relevant industry experience.
10+ years of experience in the enterprise and/or media sector, with strong technical proficiency and a deep understanding of corresponding ecosystems and businesses.
Proven ability to cultivate and maintain long-term business relationships, including a track record of successfully leading technology partnership from ideation to launch.
Outstanding project management and organisational skills with the ability to handle multiple projects, stakeholders and work streams simultaneously.
Self-motivated with proven ability to effectively prioritize and deliver tasks on schedule.
Stellar communication and presentation skills: ability to communicate verbally and in writing to a variety of audience including senior external and internal leadership.
Fluency in Chinese (Mandarin) and English.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience with head-mounted devices and interest in the spatial computing space.
Business Development and/or management consulting experience.
Strong experience and knowledge of the Chinese market with existing network and connection among major Chinese corporations. Experience in other APAC markets a plus.
Experience working for an international group a plus.

Apple-200689651.title: Subject Matter Expert - Data Science, Intern
Apple-200689651.description:
At Apple, we believe in the power of innovation and the ability to create exceptional products that change the world. Join us in Shenzhen, where you’ll be part of a dynamic team driving data-driven manufacturing excellence across advanced surface finishing technologies. As a Process Data Science  Intern dedicated to Anodizing industry, you will have the opportunity to study and contribute directly to the next generation of new color development for Apple products. You’ll collaborate closely with industry experts, color/finish engineers, and operations teams to bridge aesthetic design intent and mass production feasibility. Be part of something transformative — and help us make the world more amazing.

In this role, you will assist in advancing surface finishing technology in Anodizing industry, through data analytics, statistical modeling, and predictive process engineering tailored for new color development. You will gain deep, practical exposure to Apple's new color development workflow—from lab-scale tinting trials to pilot line validation and ramp readiness. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to transform raw factory data-log into high-yield, robust color prediction solutions for iconic Apple products.

Tailor algorithmic solutions to new color development, independently handling model architecture design, training and production deployment.
Extract, clean, and perform multidimensional deep-dive analyses on massive operational and business datasets.
Apply advanced statistical modeling and data analytics to characterize the dyeing process, leveraging data-driven insights to streamline and accelerate new color development.
Time management: set up the priority and check point for each key actions to make sure it followed with our build schedule.
Apple-200689651.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor’s degree or above (full-time) in Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or related STEM disciplines.
Available for a full-time internship, 6~12 months.
Solid foundational knowledge in computer science and applied mathematics; proficient in at least one mainstream programming language (Python, Java, or C++) with strong engineering code quality.
Hands-on R&D experience in data analytics, data mining, or machine learning algorithm/model development.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience handling messy industrial data, inline sensor telemetry, and developing automated data pipelines/visualizations (e.g., Tableau, Plotly, Streamlit).
Familiar with Linux operating environments and big data ecosystem components (e.g., Hadoop, Spark); strong data intuition and keen business acumen.
Prior internship or project experience in Anodizing, dyeing chemistry, color science or consumer hardware manufacturing.

Apple-200675580.title: Subject Matter Expert - PVD/Coatings
Apple-200675580.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, creative ideas have a way of becoming wonderful products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.
The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it!

· Participate on a team tasked with developing and implementing processes that create cosmetic and protective finishes for Apple’s world class enclosure designs.
· Investigate new materials and manufacturing methods used to coat a variety of surfaces across multiple product lines.
· Engage coating and equipment suppliers to lead investigations and identify improvements in manufacturing process and material selection.
· Lead cosmetic and functional characterization activities to define specifications with Product Design team. 
· Lead development of coating control plans and work instructions at supplier locations.
· Provide structured problem solving support, organize and prioritize investigations, and drive implementation; analyze failure root cause and implement closed-loop corrective actions to ensure timely closure of quality issues.
· Understand reliability testing requirements and drive production to meet specifications.
· Understand relationship between thin film stack design, material, coating processes and product performance. Leverage this understanding to troubleshoot production problems.
· Conduct yield gap studies and develop/implement plans to close.
· Optimize equipment and fixtures to drive process capability.
· Work with cross functional team (MD, PD and ID) to develop measurement technologies feasibility and viability to mitigate commercial and ramp risk.
· Proactively support identification / selection / qualification of new coatings and ink suppliers globally to enhance supply and technical capability of our supply chain.
Apple-200675580.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
MS in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics or equivalent.
10+ years working experience, including 5+ years experience or training in thin film manufacturing or design. 
Experience in one or more of following process technologies is must: PVD, CVD or dry etching.
Experience or skill in one of optical simulation software: macleod, TFCALC etc.
Experience leading process development in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
Experience in the selection, set-up, and validation of manufacturing equipment.
Ability to program-manage across multiple projects, vendors and resources.
Ability to present technical analysis of manufacturing capability to diverse cross-functional team.
Strong abilities and background in materials characterization (understanding of analytical tools such as SEM / TEM / EDX / FTIR / XPS etc. desirable).
Verbal and written English proficiency.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
PhD in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics or equivalent.
Materials development experience is a plus.
Experience or knowledge in pre-treatment process, ink printing is a strong plus.
Frequent domestic and some overseas travel expected. 
Experience in massive data analysis, coding and machine learning would be a plus.

Apple-200687904.title: Technial Program Manager, iPhone
Apple-200687904.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. The people here at Apple don’t just build products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, you will help us leave the world better than we found it!

As a TPM, you will lead the conceptualization, development, qualification, optimization, and scaling of new process technologies and equipment for the manufacturing of new Apple products. This is a hands-on position requiring outstanding technical skills, strong leadership capabilities, and a deep understanding of modern factory operations.

Engagement in new product engineering builds, assist in reviewing production process and fixtures from manufacturing perspectives, capable of owning hot issues & drive to closures is crucial.
Executes and implements the strategic direction, goals, objectives and key measurement systems to ensure the quality & business goals are met.
Primary metrics include - process and yield goals, monitor and audit product quality across all yield and audit points, ensure adequate controls and product integrity are set in place.
Develops, implements, and maintains policies, procedures and control systems & minimized any variation. Ensure products are scaleable across line & sites with highest quality in MP.
Acts as a bridge for technical issues when required between Apple engineering team and the vendors. Provides input into global process, test, quality, BOM Management as systems are enhanced or upgraded.
Apple-200687904.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
University or college graduated (BS/MS) with major in EE or ME related degrees, with testing background is preferable.
Validated experience supporting new product launches to mass production from a mechanical, system engineering, or product development perspective with a solid understanding of DFM, DOE, SPC & FA techniques.
Experience with mechanical assembly fixtures and manufacturing processes is required.
Good communication skills in English and Mandarin.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
With understanding and strong passion on other precise assembly processes, such as electrically conductive adhesive or glue applications are welcomed.
Familiar with mobile devices' knowledge is preferable.
Action oriented and handle conflicts - Excellent problem solver, using structured problem solving methodology to assign root cause, plus develop and implement corrective and preventative actions.
Self-starter with innovation, integrity, and attention to detail.
Approach problems with flexibility. Excellent interpersonal and communication skill with capability to work independently and under pressure.
AI/ML (Machine Learning) development & predictive operations experience is a plus.

Apple-200685041.title: Technical Analyst - Insight Team
Apple-200685041.description:
The Insight team runs one of Apple's most critical Big Data ecosystems — an exabyte-scale, highly-available infrastructure that underpins manufacturing operations for every Apple product, globally. Every iPhone, iPad, and Mac has touched our systems.
We advance technology by relying on each other's strengths and skills to build something bigger than ourselves. For this reason, team culture is central to our values. We value social skills and integrity as much as technical craft. 
The Insight team is looking for a skilled Technical Analyst to join our expanding team in China. In this role, you will serve as a technical solution provider, leveraging your deep understanding of the entire Insight platform to design data solutions for our users. It sits at the intersection of customer experience, data, and operational improvement — supporting the internal Apple teams and external manufacturing partners who depend on our platform to make critical business decisions every day.

It is a role defined by the breadth of what it touches. You will develop a deep understanding of Apple's manufacturing data ecosystem, build trusted relationships across global teams, and over time, open doors to many directions within Apple — engineering, program management, data, operations, and beyond. If you are intellectually curious, technically capable, and want to learn how Apple's supply chain works from the inside, this is an exceptional place to start.

You will work within a fast-moving operational team supporting one of Apple's most complex and business-critical data platforms. Your work directly enables the Apple engineering and operations teams that build every Apple product.
Own the end-to-end support lifecycle, from initial investigation and root cause analysis to final resolution
Translate technical findings into actionable insights for diverse audiences, including internal engineering teams and external manufacturing partners
Identify recurring issue patterns and collaborate with SRE and engineering teams to fix root causes rather than symptoms
Analyze and interpret data to build reports and visualizations that drive informed business decisions
Develop and maintain documentation, including SOPs, process flows, and knowledge base content to empower the team
Apple-200685041.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
BS or MS in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience will be fully considered
Communication: Native/fully fluent in Mandarin and highly proficient in English. Capable of translating complex technical findings into clear insights for both technical engineers and stakeholders
Problem Solving: Exceptional analytical mindset with the ability to take incomplete or ambiguous information, form structured hypotheses, and drive issues to actionable conclusions.
Data & Analytical Skills: Good SQL proficiency to extract, analyze, and validate complex datasets, coupled with solid experience in Excel or equivalent tools for foundational reporting.
Experience: Proven track record in technical support (L2/L3), business analysis, or data analyst roles within a large-scale enterprise environment.
Travel: Willingness and ability to travel (up to 20%) to various manufacturing locations across China.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Supply Chain & Business Analysis: Strong background supporting B2B platforms, manufacturing, supply chain, or operations technology environments, combined with familiarity in UAT processes and formal requirements documentation.
Data Analytics & Visualization: Proficiency in data visualization tools (Tableau, Grafana, or equivalent) to design and build operational dashboards, paired with Python scripting experience for data extraction, automation, and investigation workflows.
AI Integration & Modern Tooling: Demonstrated experience using AI tools (LLMs, AI-assisted development, agentic workflows) to develop reports and improve operational efficiency. Exposure to API integrations and MCP (Model Context Protocol) implementations is a significant advantage.
Big Data & Cloud Tech: Familiarity with big data ecosystems (Kafka, Elasticsearch, EKS) and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP). 
Scripting: Python scripting experience for data extraction, automation, or investigation workflows

Apple-200676549.title: Technical Program Manager, System in Package
Apple-200676549.description:
In this highly visible role, you will serve as the operation expert in manufacturing process, yields, and factory readiness for mass production, partnering with a cross-functional team that includes design, supplier quality, test, service, and technical program engineers.

Bring your engineering depth and program leadership to one of the most operationally complex areas at Apple. You will collaborate closely with the New Product Introduction group and our manufacturing partners to drive quality, deliver against tight timelines, and shape how Apple products are built at scale.

Apple-200684404.title: Test Lead
Apple-200684404.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, great ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. 

We are looking for an SAP Test Lead to join our Business Process Re-engineering (BPR) group. In this role, you will support planning, creating, scheduling, coordinating, and executing tests for projects within the WW SOS Operations organization. You will partner with project managers and development teams to ensure high-quality products for our business and customers while continuously improving our testing practices. Description: You will manage end-to-end test activities, including test strategy, planning, execution, team coordination, and communication. By driving the successful release of system enhancements and new functionalities through effective user acceptance testing, you will play a critical role in our operations. 

Manage end-to-end test activities, including test strategy, planning, execution, team coordination, and communication.
Drive the successful release of system enhancements and new functionalities through effective user acceptance testing.
Design and operationalize robust test data management strategies.
Develop test plans and facilitate the creation of test cases and scripts across multiple projects of varying sizes.
Facilitate end-to-end test scenario creation, bridging various functionalities through manual or automated processes.
Negotiate with cross-functional teams and business partners to remove barriers and drive results without compromising quality.
Create, maintain, and report on testing metrics, including SLAs and KPIs, while continuously improving testing best practices.
Determine the test automation approach and scope for projects, maintaining a comprehensive testing knowledge repository for the BPR team.
Apple-200684404.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor's degree.
5+ years of experience in project management or test lead positions within the software lifecycle.
Proficiency with operations and various Supply Chain functions, such as Quote to Cash, Procure to Pay, Make to Deliver, Inventory Management, and Reverse Logistics.
Familiarity with software test automation tools and frameworks, including UFT, Selenium, and Playwright.
Background in data management methodologies for data identification, validation, and maintenance.
Solid understanding of project management approaches, tools, and phases of the project lifecycle, including Agile/Scrum, Waterfall, and Iterative methodologies. 
Proficient communication skills in both English and Mandarin

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
PMI/PMP certification.
Certified Scrum Master (CSM) credential.
Track record of testing with transformations.
Supply chain technical and application competencies as a techno-functional testing professional.
Proven ability to work on projects for globally distributed teams in a matrixed, fast-paced environment.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate horizontally and vertically.
Dedication to delivering great software and releasing it quickly, efficiently, and with increased quality.

Apple-200673548.title: Test Station DRI- Beats FATP
Apple-200673548.description:
Apple is where individual imaginations capture together, committing to the values that lead to phenomenal work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something.

We are looking for individuals who possess proven experiences and passion in FATP (Final Assembly Test and Pack) test solutions development and test vendor management. We are continuously improving manufacturing test processes and solutions.

This role requires familiarity with FATP(Final Assembly, Test and Pack) testing & processes in its supply chain. The ability to work independently, good collaboration skills, and strong communications ability both in English and Mandarin are also required.

In this role, you will design & validate FATP test stations and constantly pursue new test methods as well as labor/cost reduction and automation.

You will travel (30%~50%) to both domestic and overseas suppliers’ sites for critical tasks.

Design for Testability: Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Hardware, Software, Product Design, etc.) to generate ERS and ensure system-level functionalities are tested logically and efficiently. Guide vendors on FATP fixture design, ensuring proper mechanical alignment, electrical connectivity, and robust performance in a factory environment.

Test Station Qualification: Collaborate with test station vendors to bring up FATP test stations and test coverage. Manage the calibration of test instruments and Golden Units. Use statistical tools (such as GR&R, SPC, and Cp/Cpk) to ensure test setups are repeatable and reproducible under mass-production conditions.

Failure/Data Analysis: Analyze tester-related failures (e.g., false rejects due to fixture instability or probing/contact issues) by deep diving into test theories/algorithms; define DOEs to figure out the root cause. Analyze factory test data to fine-tune test limits, optimize test methods, improve yield, and reduce test time.
Apple-200673548.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
BS/MS degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related fields.
3+ years of experience in the following areas: 1)FATP test station design for consumer electronics. 2)FATP test station qualification. Including but not limited to instrument calibration, Golden Unit correlation, repeatability, and reproducibility in a high-volume manufacturing environment. 3)System-level testing troubleshooting and circuit analysis. 

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Project and supplier (CM/OEM) management in mass production.
Acoustic test station design, including proper acoustic sealing, vibration isolation, and ambient noise rejection.
Deep understanding of acoustic metrics (Frequency Response, THD, Rub & Buzz, Sensitivity, Phase, SNR) and audio protocols (I2S, PDM, SoundWire).
Skilled in operating industry-standard acoustic measurement systems and instruments (e.g., Listen SoundCheck, Audio Precision, B&K/GRAS sensors).
Development and maintenance of software scripts and libraries. (Python, Lua, C++, etc.) for manufacturing test data analysis or test sequencing.
Developing hardware/factory test automation solutions.
Curiosity and creativity in applying AI tools.

Apple-200676309.title: UAT Manager, Apple Store Online (China)
Apple-200676309.description:
Imagine what you could do here! The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. At Apple, inclusion is a shared responsibility, and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.

Here on the Apple Store Online team, we are responsible for Apple’s largest store. Our main goal is to deliver a magical, personal digital experience where customers can shop, buy and learn everything Apple, wherever they are. Each customer should feel like they are our only customer and our job is to set the bar for the experience they receive. To run such an extraordinary store, it takes extraordinary people, and we are looking for someone to help us do extraordinary things.

Our ASO User Acceptance Testing (UAT) team is a Quality Team responsible for partnering cross functionally across Apple, with business and technical teams, to evaluate the functionality and integrity of our digital and transactional solutions. We are the quality leader chartered with validating and endorsing our digital solutions, overseeing final readiness, functionality, and the end-to-end customer journey for the Apple Store Online business and ensuring the experience that we create matches what we had envisioned for our customers. We hold ourselves to a standard where good enough is never enough — if that resonates with you, this is the team for you!

This role leads a team responsible for planning, execution, and reporting of UAT across the China region. It combines people leadership with deep technical ownership, requiring hands-on expertise across diverse customer journeys and their underlying transactional systems.
Success in this role demands strong proactiveness and inquisitiveness, the ability to anticipate risks ahead of time, and the judgment to guide the team in identifying and testing scenarios that thoroughly validate the solutions they support.

Own overall ASO project test strategy and mobilization plan, ensuring alignment with the broader ASO Portfolio.         
Represent ASO in centralized, cross-functional testing efforts, partnering across teams to drive overall project success.
Lead a team of UAT Project Managers, prioritizing resources and work streams under time constraints, while contributing to the continuous improvement of UAT processes aligned with industry best practices.
Serve as a key driver of cross-functional testing collaboration with teams across Apple, onshore/offshore, and partner teams — ensuring synergy for successful UAT execution and data-centric reporting across the UAT portfolio.       
Develop deep subject matter expertise continuously across China E2E customer journeys, Order to Cash processes, and impacted systems to drive comprehensive UAT testing strategies, applying strong AI/ML validation skills, and an automation-first mindset.
Lead through ambiguity, providing clear, goal-oriented direction to teams that turns uncertainty into actions.
Apple-200676309.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
7+ years in UAT/QA/Quality e-commerce (online/marketplaces) transactional testing and project management experience navigating complex, integrated systems with aggressive timeline in both Waterfall and Agile landscapes.
3+ years of demonstrated leadership of a UAT/QA/Quality organization, testing resource management and experience attracting and retaining high-performing talent while fostering an inclusive, values-driven team culture.
Proficiency in test planning and scripting, with experience implementing manual and automation test strategies to drive test efficiency.
BA/BS degree in a business or technical field, or 10+ years relevant professional experience.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent communication skills, with a proactive ability to identify concerns early and rally teams to mitigate risks timely.
Demonstrates attention to detail, quality first mindset, and enjoys both hands-on work and high-level strategic thinking with a genuine passion for innovation and continuous process improvement.
Proven relationship-building skills, established as a trusted advisor to partner teams, with strong facilitation, negotiation, and conflict resolution capabilities.
Sees around corners, identifies potential areas of concern, has a sense of urgency, and can rally teams to review and mitigate risk in a program. 
Is open to feedback, self-motivated and enthusiastic, enjoys solving problems with teammates, and has demonstrated creative and critical thinking capabilities.
Has worked within a regional / global organization. 
PMP or Certified Scrum Master is a plus.

Join a team dedicated to shaping how Apple Retail Customer Care specialists learn, adapt, and deliver exceptional support every day. As a Content Developer, you’ll create and maintain the knowledge base documentation that lives in our specialist-facing tools, occasionally extending into training content, to keep our global RCC organization informed, aligned, and ready for what’s next. This role is built for someone who thrives on ambiguity, moves quickly without losing sight of the details, and is energized by fast-moving, high-intensity projects. If you love turning complexity into clarity, we want to hear from you.

As a Content Developer on the RCC Content Development team, you’ll own the end-to-end creation, editing, and publishing of knowledge base documentation that keeps Retail Customer Care specialists equipped to support customers. You’ll balance day-to-day business update requests with larger project work, partnering across teams to keep content accurate, clear, and launch-ready. This role requires managing multiple priorities at once while working independently in a fast-moving environment.
• Write, edit, and publish documentation using internal tools and content management systems
• Partner with project teams to identify documentation that needs to be created, updated, or retired, and track progress against timelines
• Validate business update requests for accuracy and clarity, resolving conflicting or duplicate content
• Partner with the WW Instructional Design team as needed to develop regional-specific training content that supports documentation rollout and launch readiness

• Work independently and take full ownership of assigned projects and content with minimal day-to-day oversight
• Manage multiple projects and business update requests simultaneously, prioritizing deliverables in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
• Ensure content is clear, consistent, and free of conflicting or duplicate information
• Partner with global business owners and cross-functional stakeholders to validate information before publishing, communicating proactively across time zones
• Track and report on project progress, identifying documentation impacted by upcoming changes
• Adapt quickly to shifting priorities and incomplete information without losing momentum

• Strict adherence to confidentiality and content-handling policies

Apple-200663491.title: iPad Product Design Intern
Apple-200663491.description:
As part of our Mac/Input Devices Engineering team, you will help craft creative input devices solutions that facilitate people communicating with multiple devices. You will work across disciplines to transform improved hardware elements into a single, integrated design. You will help us innovate new technologies that continuously outperform the previous iterations. By collaborating with other product development groups across Apple, you will push the industry boundaries of what a Mac/input device can do and improve the product experience for our customers across the world.  The Mac/Input Devices Engineering team at Apple produces innovative and highly reliable systems for Apple product lines. Tightly integrated with Product Development, Operations, Industrial Design and Reliability Testing groups, you will help coordinate and execute the overall product designs from beginning to end.

Brainstorms design concepts and executes design concepts in all phases of a development cycle Generates innovative designs with cross-functional teams, including detailed written specifications, drawings and tolerance analysis Defines and executes design validation and characterization from prototype bring-up to product testing Develops designs and processes with external vendors, acting as product development technical liaison among vendors Communicates multi-functionally on design directions and requirements Manages and tracks multiple priorities within schedule requirements and drives multiple vendors towards common project goals Conducts design reviews and drives file release process Drives failure analyses and design of experiments (DOEs) to reach design solutions and corrective actions Drives design towards Apple's cosmetic requirements Communicates status effectively throughout the team

Mechanical CAD Design: Build 3D models and 2D engineering drawings for components and sub-assembly
Technology Benchmarking & Analysis: Research and evaluate new materials, advanced manufacturing methods, and novel mechanical architectures.
Enclosure & Surface Tech: Support lab characterization and DOE studies for advanced alloys, CNC/forming processes, and cosmetic finishing technologies (anodizing, coatings, textures).
Tolerance & Fit: Perform tolerance stack-ups and apply basic GD&T to ensure precise cosmetic seams and clearances.
Prototyping & Lab Testing: Build rapid mockups and run mechanical tests to validate designs.
Apple-200663491.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Currently Pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, or related field.
Solid fundamentals in Statics, Dynamics, and Mechanics of Materials.
Hands-on experience with 3D CAD software (NX, Creo, SolidWorks, or CATIA).
Basic understanding of GD&T and 2D drawings.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Familiarity with standard manufacturing methods (CNC, sheet metal, injection molding).
Prior internship, club, or portfolio project in consumer electronics or hardware design.
Hands-on mechanical lab experience (prototyping, material characterization, force/tensile testing).
Familiarity with metal surface finishing processes (anodizing, bead-blasting, PVD) or cosmetic defect analysis.
Basic knowledge of FEA simulation (Abaqus, ANSYS).
Practical understanding of DFM/DFA principles.
